Sentence (English): My hand suddenly started hurting, so I hurriedly bought a dishwasher.
Comments (English): My hand suddenly started hurting, so I hurriedly bought a dishwasher. I had initially paid for a 6-place setting model, but my husband told me to get a bigger one since I was buying one anyway, so I quickly canceled that and bought this model without doing much research or finding any reviews. The result is satisfying. The exterior is stylish and pretty; it's a beige-pink tone and blends well with my white sink. It lacks steam and hot air drying functions, but the temperature is high enough to crush a plastic water bottle from Daiso. The technician said it is between 50 and 80 degrees. With the high-temperature drying function and the automatic door opening feature, it dries about 90%—only the water pooled at the top of cups doesn't dry completely. If you touch them a bit after it finishes, they dry completely. As for washing, the dishes came out sparkling clean. It even cleans the frying pan I used to grill pork belly well. After doing some research on dishwashers after purchasing it, I learned that the cleaning power of modern dishwashers depends on the detergent. I tried various cycles, and since the 1-hour cycle plus high-temperature drying takes about the same amount of time as the powerful cycle, I end up using the powerful or automatic cycles. I've tried the 1-hour cycle without drying plus an extra rinse, but personally, I dislike the dripping water, so I only use it when I'm in a hurry. I run the top-loading quick wash in the morning and the powerful cycle fully loaded in the evening, so I run it twice a day. I really love that it has the top-loading quick wash course. Also, I was surprised by how much there was to wash in the evening; I realized my hands and wrists have been under constant abuse all this time. My husband saw me pre-washing and asked if I really had to go to such lengths to put the dishes in, asking what good that does, but it helps a lot! I used to cut fruit for him and then do the dishes, but now we can sit down and eat fruit together! It's so good. That said, it's not without its downsides. I bought this in a hurry after comparing it to a 6-person model, so I assumed a cutlery holder was standard, but it turns out there is a 3-tier one. The cutlery holder is too big, takes up a lot of space, and is a bit inconvenient, so I ended up not using it. However, if I place the cutlery and utensils between the dishes so they don't fall through or get caught, it cleans really well. If you sell a smaller cutlery holder, I would be willing to buy it, but the 3-tier design is a bit disappointing. Also, if the sink needs to be cut during installation, you shouldn't expect a high-quality finish. Since ours is old, we just accepted it, but I think it would be upsetting for a new house. Lastly, after only 4 days of using the dishwasher, the fixing part at the end of the second-tier rail came off, as shown in the picture. I wondered what was wrong. I managed to put it back on with pliers, but it isn't very sturdy. They only checked for cosmetic defects during installation. Please inspect thoroughly. Still, it is an appliance where the advantages feel far greater than the disadvantages. It has made things so much easier, so I am satisfied. Dishwasher Lady, I hope you have a great time!

Sentence (English): The result is satisfying.
Comments (English): My hand suddenly started hurting, so I hurriedly bought a dishwasher. I had initially paid for a 6-place setting model, but my husband told me to get a bigger one since I was buying one anyway, so I quickly canceled that and bought this model without doing much research or finding any reviews. The result is satisfying. The exterior is stylish and pretty; it's a beige-pink tone and blends well with my white sink. It lacks steam and hot air drying functions, but the temperature is high enough to crush a plastic water bottle from Daiso. The technician said it is between 50 and 80 degrees. With the high-temperature drying function and the automatic door opening feature, it dries about 90%—only the water pooled at the top of cups doesn't dry completely. If you touch them a bit after it finishes, they dry completely. As for washing, the dishes came out sparkling clean. It even cleans the frying pan I used to grill pork belly well. After doing some research on dishwashers after purchasing it, I learned that the cleaning power of modern dishwashers depends on the detergent. I tried various cycles, and since the 1-hour cycle plus high-temperature drying takes about the same amount of time as the powerful cycle, I end up using the powerful or automatic cycles. I've tried the 1-hour cycle without drying plus an extra rinse, but personally, I dislike the dripping water, so I only use it when I'm in a hurry. I run the top-loading quick wash in the morning and the powerful cycle fully loaded in the evening, so I run it twice a day. I really love that it has the top-loading quick wash course. Also, I was surprised by how much there was to wash in the evening; I realized my hands and wrists have been under constant abuse all this time. My husband saw me pre-washing and asked if I really had to go to such lengths to put the dishes in, asking what good that does, but it helps a lot! I used to cut fruit for him and then do the dishes, but now we can sit down and eat fruit together! It's so good. That said, it's not without its downsides. I bought this in a hurry after comparing it to a 6-person model, so I assumed a cutlery holder was standard, but it turns out there is a 3-tier one. The cutlery holder is too big, takes up a lot of space, and is a bit inconvenient, so I ended up not using it. However, if I place the cutlery and utensils between the dishes so they don't fall through or get caught, it cleans really well. If you sell a smaller cutlery holder, I would be willing to buy it, but the 3-tier design is a bit disappointing. Also, if the sink needs to be cut during installation, you shouldn't expect a high-quality finish. Since ours is old, we just accepted it, but I think it would be upsetting for a new house. Lastly, after only 4 days of using the dishwasher, the fixing part at the end of the second-tier rail came off, as shown in the picture. I wondered what was wrong. I managed to put it back on with pliers, but it isn't very sturdy. They only checked for cosmetic defects during installation. Please inspect thoroughly. Still, it is an appliance where the advantages feel far greater than the disadvantages. It has made things so much easier, so I am satisfied. Dishwasher Lady, I hope you have a great time!

Sentence (English): The technician said it is between 50 and 80 degrees.
Comments (English): My hand suddenly started hurting, so I hurriedly bought a dishwasher. I had initially paid for a 6-place setting model, but my husband told me to get a bigger one since I was buying one anyway, so I quickly canceled that and bought this model without doing much research or finding any reviews. The result is satisfying. The exterior is stylish and pretty; it's a beige-pink tone and blends well with my white sink. It lacks steam and hot air drying functions, but the temperature is high enough to crush a plastic water bottle from Daiso. The technician said it is between 50 and 80 degrees. With the high-temperature drying function and the automatic door opening feature, it dries about 90%—only the water pooled at the top of cups doesn't dry completely. If you touch them a bit after it finishes, they dry completely. As for washing, the dishes came out sparkling clean. It even cleans the frying pan I used to grill pork belly well. After doing some research on dishwashers after purchasing it, I learned that the cleaning power of modern dishwashers depends on the detergent. I tried various cycles, and since the 1-hour cycle plus high-temperature drying takes about the same amount of time as the powerful cycle, I end up using the powerful or automatic cycles. I've tried the 1-hour cycle without drying plus an extra rinse, but personally, I dislike the dripping water, so I only use it when I'm in a hurry. I run the top-loading quick wash in the morning and the powerful cycle fully loaded in the evening, so I run it twice a day. I really love that it has the top-loading quick wash course. Also, I was surprised by how much there was to wash in the evening; I realized my hands and wrists have been under constant abuse all this time. My husband saw me pre-washing and asked if I really had to go to such lengths to put the dishes in, asking what good that does, but it helps a lot! I used to cut fruit for him and then do the dishes, but now we can sit down and eat fruit together! It's so good. That said, it's not without its downsides. I bought this in a hurry after comparing it to a 6-person model, so I assumed a cutlery holder was standard, but it turns out there is a 3-tier one. The cutlery holder is too big, takes up a lot of space, and is a bit inconvenient, so I ended up not using it. However, if I place the cutlery and utensils between the dishes so they don't fall through or get caught, it cleans really well. If you sell a smaller cutlery holder, I would be willing to buy it, but the 3-tier design is a bit disappointing. Also, if the sink needs to be cut during installation, you shouldn't expect a high-quality finish. Since ours is old, we just accepted it, but I think it would be upsetting for a new house. Lastly, after only 4 days of using the dishwasher, the fixing part at the end of the second-tier rail came off, as shown in the picture. I wondered what was wrong. I managed to put it back on with pliers, but it isn't very sturdy. They only checked for cosmetic defects during installation. Please inspect thoroughly. Still, it is an appliance where the advantages feel far greater than the disadvantages. It has made things so much easier, so I am satisfied. Dishwasher Lady, I hope you have a great time!

Sentence (English): As for washing, the dishes came out sparkling clean.
Comments (English): My hand suddenly started hurting, so I hurriedly bought a dishwasher. I had initially paid for a 6-place setting model, but my husband told me to get a bigger one since I was buying one anyway, so I quickly canceled that and bought this model without doing much research or finding any reviews. The result is satisfying. The exterior is stylish and pretty; it's a beige-pink tone and blends well with my white sink. It lacks steam and hot air drying functions, but the temperature is high enough to crush a plastic water bottle from Daiso. The technician said it is between 50 and 80 degrees. With the high-temperature drying function and the automatic door opening feature, it dries about 90%—only the water pooled at the top of cups doesn't dry completely. If you touch them a bit after it finishes, they dry completely. As for washing, the dishes came out sparkling clean. It even cleans the frying pan I used to grill pork belly well. After doing some research on dishwashers after purchasing it, I learned that the cleaning power of modern dishwashers depends on the detergent. I tried various cycles, and since the 1-hour cycle plus high-temperature drying takes about the same amount of time as the powerful cycle, I end up using the powerful or automatic cycles. I've tried the 1-hour cycle without drying plus an extra rinse, but personally, I dislike the dripping water, so I only use it when I'm in a hurry. I run the top-loading quick wash in the morning and the powerful cycle fully loaded in the evening, so I run it twice a day. I really love that it has the top-loading quick wash course. Also, I was surprised by how much there was to wash in the evening; I realized my hands and wrists have been under constant abuse all this time. My husband saw me pre-washing and asked if I really had to go to such lengths to put the dishes in, asking what good that does, but it helps a lot! I used to cut fruit for him and then do the dishes, but now we can sit down and eat fruit together! It's so good. That said, it's not without its downsides. I bought this in a hurry after comparing it to a 6-person model, so I assumed a cutlery holder was standard, but it turns out there is a 3-tier one. The cutlery holder is too big, takes up a lot of space, and is a bit inconvenient, so I ended up not using it. However, if I place the cutlery and utensils between the dishes so they don't fall through or get caught, it cleans really well. If you sell a smaller cutlery holder, I would be willing to buy it, but the 3-tier design is a bit disappointing. Also, if the sink needs to be cut during installation, you shouldn't expect a high-quality finish. Since ours is old, we just accepted it, but I think it would be upsetting for a new house. Lastly, after only 4 days of using the dishwasher, the fixing part at the end of the second-tier rail came off, as shown in the picture. I wondered what was wrong. I managed to put it back on with pliers, but it isn't very sturdy. They only checked for cosmetic defects during installation. Please inspect thoroughly. Still, it is an appliance where the advantages feel far greater than the disadvantages. It has made things so much easier, so I am satisfied. Dishwasher Lady, I hope you have a great time!

Sentence (English): I tried various cycles, and since the 1-hour cycle plus high-temperature drying takes about the same amount of time as the powerful cycle, I end up using the powerful or automatic cycles.
Comments (English): My hand suddenly started hurting, so I hurriedly bought a dishwasher. I had initially paid for a 6-place setting model, but my husband told me to get a bigger one since I was buying one anyway, so I quickly canceled that and bought this model without doing much research or finding any reviews. The result is satisfying. The exterior is stylish and pretty; it's a beige-pink tone and blends well with my white sink. It lacks steam and hot air drying functions, but the temperature is high enough to crush a plastic water bottle from Daiso. The technician said it is between 50 and 80 degrees. With the high-temperature drying function and the automatic door opening feature, it dries about 90%—only the water pooled at the top of cups doesn't dry completely. If you touch them a bit after it finishes, they dry completely. As for washing, the dishes came out sparkling clean. It even cleans the frying pan I used to grill pork belly well. After doing some research on dishwashers after purchasing it, I learned that the cleaning power of modern dishwashers depends on the detergent. I tried various cycles, and since the 1-hour cycle plus high-temperature drying takes about the same amount of time as the powerful cycle, I end up using the powerful or automatic cycles. I've tried the 1-hour cycle without drying plus an extra rinse, but personally, I dislike the dripping water, so I only use it when I'm in a hurry. I run the top-loading quick wash in the morning and the powerful cycle fully loaded in the evening, so I run it twice a day. I really love that it has the top-loading quick wash course. Also, I was surprised by how much there was to wash in the evening; I realized my hands and wrists have been under constant abuse all this time. My husband saw me pre-washing and asked if I really had to go to such lengths to put the dishes in, asking what good that does, but it helps a lot! I used to cut fruit for him and then do the dishes, but now we can sit down and eat fruit together! It's so good. That said, it's not without its downsides. I bought this in a hurry after comparing it to a 6-person model, so I assumed a cutlery holder was standard, but it turns out there is a 3-tier one. The cutlery holder is too big, takes up a lot of space, and is a bit inconvenient, so I ended up not using it. However, if I place the cutlery and utensils between the dishes so they don't fall through or get caught, it cleans really well. If you sell a smaller cutlery holder, I would be willing to buy it, but the 3-tier design is a bit disappointing. Also, if the sink needs to be cut during installation, you shouldn't expect a high-quality finish. Since ours is old, we just accepted it, but I think it would be upsetting for a new house. Lastly, after only 4 days of using the dishwasher, the fixing part at the end of the second-tier rail came off, as shown in the picture. I wondered what was wrong. I managed to put it back on with pliers, but it isn't very sturdy. They only checked for cosmetic defects during installation. Please inspect thoroughly. Still, it is an appliance where the advantages feel far greater than the disadvantages. It has made things so much easier, so I am satisfied. Dishwasher Lady, I hope you have a great time!

Sentence (English): I really love that it has the top-loading quick wash course.
Comments (English): My hand suddenly started hurting, so I hurriedly bought a dishwasher. I had initially paid for a 6-place setting model, but my husband told me to get a bigger one since I was buying one anyway, so I quickly canceled that and bought this model without doing much research or finding any reviews. The result is satisfying. The exterior is stylish and pretty; it's a beige-pink tone and blends well with my white sink. It lacks steam and hot air drying functions, but the temperature is high enough to crush a plastic water bottle from Daiso. The technician said it is between 50 and 80 degrees. With the high-temperature drying function and the automatic door opening feature, it dries about 90%—only the water pooled at the top of cups doesn't dry completely. If you touch them a bit after it finishes, they dry completely. As for washing, the dishes came out sparkling clean. It even cleans the frying pan I used to grill pork belly well. After doing some research on dishwashers after purchasing it, I learned that the cleaning power of modern dishwashers depends on the detergent. I tried various cycles, and since the 1-hour cycle plus high-temperature drying takes about the same amount of time as the powerful cycle, I end up using the powerful or automatic cycles. I've tried the 1-hour cycle without drying plus an extra rinse, but personally, I dislike the dripping water, so I only use it when I'm in a hurry. I run the top-loading quick wash in the morning and the powerful cycle fully loaded in the evening, so I run it twice a day. I really love that it has the top-loading quick wash course. Also, I was surprised by how much there was to wash in the evening; I realized my hands and wrists have been under constant abuse all this time. My husband saw me pre-washing and asked if I really had to go to such lengths to put the dishes in, asking what good that does, but it helps a lot! I used to cut fruit for him and then do the dishes, but now we can sit down and eat fruit together! It's so good. That said, it's not without its downsides. I bought this in a hurry after comparing it to a 6-person model, so I assumed a cutlery holder was standard, but it turns out there is a 3-tier one. The cutlery holder is too big, takes up a lot of space, and is a bit inconvenient, so I ended up not using it. However, if I place the cutlery and utensils between the dishes so they don't fall through or get caught, it cleans really well. If you sell a smaller cutlery holder, I would be willing to buy it, but the 3-tier design is a bit disappointing. Also, if the sink needs to be cut during installation, you shouldn't expect a high-quality finish. Since ours is old, we just accepted it, but I think it would be upsetting for a new house. Lastly, after only 4 days of using the dishwasher, the fixing part at the end of the second-tier rail came off, as shown in the picture. I wondered what was wrong. I managed to put it back on with pliers, but it isn't very sturdy. They only checked for cosmetic defects during installation. Please inspect thoroughly. Still, it is an appliance where the advantages feel far greater than the disadvantages. It has made things so much easier, so I am satisfied. Dishwasher Lady, I hope you have a great time!

Sentence (English): I used to cut fruit for him and then do the dishes, but now we can sit down and eat fruit together!
Comments (English): My hand suddenly started hurting, so I hurriedly bought a dishwasher. I had initially paid for a 6-place setting model, but my husband told me to get a bigger one since I was buying one anyway, so I quickly canceled that and bought this model without doing much research or finding any reviews. The result is satisfying. The exterior is stylish and pretty; it's a beige-pink tone and blends well with my white sink. It lacks steam and hot air drying functions, but the temperature is high enough to crush a plastic water bottle from Daiso. The technician said it is between 50 and 80 degrees. With the high-temperature drying function and the automatic door opening feature, it dries about 90%—only the water pooled at the top of cups doesn't dry completely. If you touch them a bit after it finishes, they dry completely. As for washing, the dishes came out sparkling clean. It even cleans the frying pan I used to grill pork belly well. After doing some research on dishwashers after purchasing it, I learned that the cleaning power of modern dishwashers depends on the detergent. I tried various cycles, and since the 1-hour cycle plus high-temperature drying takes about the same amount of time as the powerful cycle, I end up using the powerful or automatic cycles. I've tried the 1-hour cycle without drying plus an extra rinse, but personally, I dislike the dripping water, so I only use it when I'm in a hurry. I run the top-loading quick wash in the morning and the powerful cycle fully loaded in the evening, so I run it twice a day. I really love that it has the top-loading quick wash course. Also, I was surprised by how much there was to wash in the evening; I realized my hands and wrists have been under constant abuse all this time. My husband saw me pre-washing and asked if I really had to go to such lengths to put the dishes in, asking what good that does, but it helps a lot! I used to cut fruit for him and then do the dishes, but now we can sit down and eat fruit together! It's so good. That said, it's not without its downsides. I bought this in a hurry after comparing it to a 6-person model, so I assumed a cutlery holder was standard, but it turns out there is a 3-tier one. The cutlery holder is too big, takes up a lot of space, and is a bit inconvenient, so I ended up not using it. However, if I place the cutlery and utensils between the dishes so they don't fall through or get caught, it cleans really well. If you sell a smaller cutlery holder, I would be willing to buy it, but the 3-tier design is a bit disappointing. Also, if the sink needs to be cut during installation, you shouldn't expect a high-quality finish. Since ours is old, we just accepted it, but I think it would be upsetting for a new house. Lastly, after only 4 days of using the dishwasher, the fixing part at the end of the second-tier rail came off, as shown in the picture. I wondered what was wrong. I managed to put it back on with pliers, but it isn't very sturdy. They only checked for cosmetic defects during installation. Please inspect thoroughly. Still, it is an appliance where the advantages feel far greater than the disadvantages. It has made things so much easier, so I am satisfied. Dishwasher Lady, I hope you have a great time!

Sentence (English): I bought this in a hurry after comparing it to a 6-person model, so I assumed a cutlery holder was standard, but it turns out there is a 3-tier one.
Comments (English): My hand suddenly started hurting, so I hurriedly bought a dishwasher. I had initially paid for a 6-place setting model, but my husband told me to get a bigger one since I was buying one anyway, so I quickly canceled that and bought this model without doing much research or finding any reviews. The result is satisfying. The exterior is stylish and pretty; it's a beige-pink tone and blends well with my white sink. It lacks steam and hot air drying functions, but the temperature is high enough to crush a plastic water bottle from Daiso. The technician said it is between 50 and 80 degrees. With the high-temperature drying function and the automatic door opening feature, it dries about 90%—only the water pooled at the top of cups doesn't dry completely. If you touch them a bit after it finishes, they dry completely. As for washing, the dishes came out sparkling clean. It even cleans the frying pan I used to grill pork belly well. After doing some research on dishwashers after purchasing it, I learned that the cleaning power of modern dishwashers depends on the detergent. I tried various cycles, and since the 1-hour cycle plus high-temperature drying takes about the same amount of time as the powerful cycle, I end up using the powerful or automatic cycles. I've tried the 1-hour cycle without drying plus an extra rinse, but personally, I dislike the dripping water, so I only use it when I'm in a hurry. I run the top-loading quick wash in the morning and the powerful cycle fully loaded in the evening, so I run it twice a day. I really love that it has the top-loading quick wash course. Also, I was surprised by how much there was to wash in the evening; I realized my hands and wrists have been under constant abuse all this time. My husband saw me pre-washing and asked if I really had to go to such lengths to put the dishes in, asking what good that does, but it helps a lot! I used to cut fruit for him and then do the dishes, but now we can sit down and eat fruit together! It's so good. That said, it's not without its downsides. I bought this in a hurry after comparing it to a 6-person model, so I assumed a cutlery holder was standard, but it turns out there is a 3-tier one. The cutlery holder is too big, takes up a lot of space, and is a bit inconvenient, so I ended up not using it. However, if I place the cutlery and utensils between the dishes so they don't fall through or get caught, it cleans really well. If you sell a smaller cutlery holder, I would be willing to buy it, but the 3-tier design is a bit disappointing. Also, if the sink needs to be cut during installation, you shouldn't expect a high-quality finish. Since ours is old, we just accepted it, but I think it would be upsetting for a new house. Lastly, after only 4 days of using the dishwasher, the fixing part at the end of the second-tier rail came off, as shown in the picture. I wondered what was wrong. I managed to put it back on with pliers, but it isn't very sturdy. They only checked for cosmetic defects during installation. Please inspect thoroughly. Still, it is an appliance where the advantages feel far greater than the disadvantages. It has made things so much easier, so I am satisfied. Dishwasher Lady, I hope you have a great time!

Sentence (English): The cutlery holder is too big, takes up a lot of space, and is a bit inconvenient, so I ended up not using it.
Comments (English): My hand suddenly started hurting, so I hurriedly bought a dishwasher. I had initially paid for a 6-place setting model, but my husband told me to get a bigger one since I was buying one anyway, so I quickly canceled that and bought this model without doing much research or finding any reviews. The result is satisfying. The exterior is stylish and pretty; it's a beige-pink tone and blends well with my white sink. It lacks steam and hot air drying functions, but the temperature is high enough to crush a plastic water bottle from Daiso. The technician said it is between 50 and 80 degrees. With the high-temperature drying function and the automatic door opening feature, it dries about 90%—only the water pooled at the top of cups doesn't dry completely. If you touch them a bit after it finishes, they dry completely. As for washing, the dishes came out sparkling clean. It even cleans the frying pan I used to grill pork belly well. After doing some research on dishwashers after purchasing it, I learned that the cleaning power of modern dishwashers depends on the detergent. I tried various cycles, and since the 1-hour cycle plus high-temperature drying takes about the same amount of time as the powerful cycle, I end up using the powerful or automatic cycles. I've tried the 1-hour cycle without drying plus an extra rinse, but personally, I dislike the dripping water, so I only use it when I'm in a hurry. I run the top-loading quick wash in the morning and the powerful cycle fully loaded in the evening, so I run it twice a day. I really love that it has the top-loading quick wash course. Also, I was surprised by how much there was to wash in the evening; I realized my hands and wrists have been under constant abuse all this time. My husband saw me pre-washing and asked if I really had to go to such lengths to put the dishes in, asking what good that does, but it helps a lot! I used to cut fruit for him and then do the dishes, but now we can sit down and eat fruit together! It's so good. That said, it's not without its downsides. I bought this in a hurry after comparing it to a 6-person model, so I assumed a cutlery holder was standard, but it turns out there is a 3-tier one. The cutlery holder is too big, takes up a lot of space, and is a bit inconvenient, so I ended up not using it. However, if I place the cutlery and utensils between the dishes so they don't fall through or get caught, it cleans really well. If you sell a smaller cutlery holder, I would be willing to buy it, but the 3-tier design is a bit disappointing. Also, if the sink needs to be cut during installation, you shouldn't expect a high-quality finish. Since ours is old, we just accepted it, but I think it would be upsetting for a new house. Lastly, after only 4 days of using the dishwasher, the fixing part at the end of the second-tier rail came off, as shown in the picture. I wondered what was wrong. I managed to put it back on with pliers, but it isn't very sturdy. They only checked for cosmetic defects during installation. Please inspect thoroughly. Still, it is an appliance where the advantages feel far greater than the disadvantages. It has made things so much easier, so I am satisfied. Dishwasher Lady, I hope you have a great time!

Sentence (English): If you sell a smaller cutlery holder, I would be willing to buy it, but the 3-tier design is a bit disappointing.
Comments (English): My hand suddenly started hurting, so I hurriedly bought a dishwasher. I had initially paid for a 6-place setting model, but my husband told me to get a bigger one since I was buying one anyway, so I quickly canceled that and bought this model without doing much research or finding any reviews. The result is satisfying. The exterior is stylish and pretty; it's a beige-pink tone and blends well with my white sink. It lacks steam and hot air drying functions, but the temperature is high enough to crush a plastic water bottle from Daiso. The technician said it is between 50 and 80 degrees. With the high-temperature drying function and the automatic door opening feature, it dries about 90%—only the water pooled at the top of cups doesn't dry completely. If you touch them a bit after it finishes, they dry completely. As for washing, the dishes came out sparkling clean. It even cleans the frying pan I used to grill pork belly well. After doing some research on dishwashers after purchasing it, I learned that the cleaning power of modern dishwashers depends on the detergent. I tried various cycles, and since the 1-hour cycle plus high-temperature drying takes about the same amount of time as the powerful cycle, I end up using the powerful or automatic cycles. I've tried the 1-hour cycle without drying plus an extra rinse, but personally, I dislike the dripping water, so I only use it when I'm in a hurry. I run the top-loading quick wash in the morning and the powerful cycle fully loaded in the evening, so I run it twice a day. I really love that it has the top-loading quick wash course. Also, I was surprised by how much there was to wash in the evening; I realized my hands and wrists have been under constant abuse all this time. My husband saw me pre-washing and asked if I really had to go to such lengths to put the dishes in, asking what good that does, but it helps a lot! I used to cut fruit for him and then do the dishes, but now we can sit down and eat fruit together! It's so good. That said, it's not without its downsides. I bought this in a hurry after comparing it to a 6-person model, so I assumed a cutlery holder was standard, but it turns out there is a 3-tier one. The cutlery holder is too big, takes up a lot of space, and is a bit inconvenient, so I ended up not using it. However, if I place the cutlery and utensils between the dishes so they don't fall through or get caught, it cleans really well. If you sell a smaller cutlery holder, I would be willing to buy it, but the 3-tier design is a bit disappointing. Also, if the sink needs to be cut during installation, you shouldn't expect a high-quality finish. Since ours is old, we just accepted it, but I think it would be upsetting for a new house. Lastly, after only 4 days of using the dishwasher, the fixing part at the end of the second-tier rail came off, as shown in the picture. I wondered what was wrong. I managed to put it back on with pliers, but it isn't very sturdy. They only checked for cosmetic defects during installation. Please inspect thoroughly. Still, it is an appliance where the advantages feel far greater than the disadvantages. It has made things so much easier, so I am satisfied. Dishwasher Lady, I hope you have a great time!

Sentence (English): Since ours is old, we just accepted it, but I think it would be upsetting for a new house.
Comments (English): My hand suddenly started hurting, so I hurriedly bought a dishwasher. I had initially paid for a 6-place setting model, but my husband told me to get a bigger one since I was buying one anyway, so I quickly canceled that and bought this model without doing much research or finding any reviews. The result is satisfying. The exterior is stylish and pretty; it's a beige-pink tone and blends well with my white sink. It lacks steam and hot air drying functions, but the temperature is high enough to crush a plastic water bottle from Daiso. The technician said it is between 50 and 80 degrees. With the high-temperature drying function and the automatic door opening feature, it dries about 90%—only the water pooled at the top of cups doesn't dry completely. If you touch them a bit after it finishes, they dry completely. As for washing, the dishes came out sparkling clean. It even cleans the frying pan I used to grill pork belly well. After doing some research on dishwashers after purchasing it, I learned that the cleaning power of modern dishwashers depends on the detergent. I tried various cycles, and since the 1-hour cycle plus high-temperature drying takes about the same amount of time as the powerful cycle, I end up using the powerful or automatic cycles. I've tried the 1-hour cycle without drying plus an extra rinse, but personally, I dislike the dripping water, so I only use it when I'm in a hurry. I run the top-loading quick wash in the morning and the powerful cycle fully loaded in the evening, so I run it twice a day. I really love that it has the top-loading quick wash course. Also, I was surprised by how much there was to wash in the evening; I realized my hands and wrists have been under constant abuse all this time. My husband saw me pre-washing and asked if I really had to go to such lengths to put the dishes in, asking what good that does, but it helps a lot! I used to cut fruit for him and then do the dishes, but now we can sit down and eat fruit together! It's so good. That said, it's not without its downsides. I bought this in a hurry after comparing it to a 6-person model, so I assumed a cutlery holder was standard, but it turns out there is a 3-tier one. The cutlery holder is too big, takes up a lot of space, and is a bit inconvenient, so I ended up not using it. However, if I place the cutlery and utensils between the dishes so they don't fall through or get caught, it cleans really well. If you sell a smaller cutlery holder, I would be willing to buy it, but the 3-tier design is a bit disappointing. Also, if the sink needs to be cut during installation, you shouldn't expect a high-quality finish. Since ours is old, we just accepted it, but I think it would be upsetting for a new house. Lastly, after only 4 days of using the dishwasher, the fixing part at the end of the second-tier rail came off, as shown in the picture. I wondered what was wrong. I managed to put it back on with pliers, but it isn't very sturdy. They only checked for cosmetic defects during installation. Please inspect thoroughly. Still, it is an appliance where the advantages feel far greater than the disadvantages. It has made things so much easier, so I am satisfied. Dishwasher Lady, I hope you have a great time!

Comments (English): My hand suddenly started hurting, so I hurriedly bought a dishwasher. I had initially paid for a 6-place setting model, but my husband told me to get a bigger one since I was buying one anyway, so I quickly canceled that and bought this model without doing much research or finding any reviews. The result is satisfying. The exterior is stylish and pretty; it's a beige-pink tone and blends well with my white sink. It lacks steam and hot air drying functions, but the temperature is high enough to crush a plastic water bottle from Daiso. The technician said it is between 50 and 80 degrees. With the high-temperature drying function and the automatic door opening feature, it dries about 90%—only the water pooled at the top of cups doesn't dry completely. If you touch them a bit after it finishes, they dry completely. As for washing, the dishes came out sparkling clean. It even cleans the frying pan I used to grill pork belly well. After doing some research on dishwashers after purchasing it, I learned that the cleaning power of modern dishwashers depends on the detergent. I tried various cycles, and since the 1-hour cycle plus high-temperature drying takes about the same amount of time as the powerful cycle, I end up using the powerful or automatic cycles. I've tried the 1-hour cycle without drying plus an extra rinse, but personally, I dislike the dripping water, so I only use it when I'm in a hurry. I run the top-loading quick wash in the morning and the powerful cycle fully loaded in the evening, so I run it twice a day. I really love that it has the top-loading quick wash course. Also, I was surprised by how much there was to wash in the evening; I realized my hands and wrists have been under constant abuse all this time. My husband saw me pre-washing and asked if I really had to go to such lengths to put the dishes in, asking what good that does, but it helps a lot! I used to cut fruit for him and then do the dishes, but now we can sit down and eat fruit together! It's so good. That said, it's not without its downsides. I bought this in a hurry after comparing it to a 6-person model, so I assumed a cutlery holder was standard, but it turns out there is a 3-tier one. The cutlery holder is too big, takes up a lot of space, and is a bit inconvenient, so I ended up not using it. However, if I place the cutlery and utensils between the dishes so they don't fall through or get caught, it cleans really well. If you sell a smaller cutlery holder, I would be willing to buy it, but the 3-tier design is a bit disappointing. Also, if the sink needs to be cut during installation, you shouldn't expect a high-quality finish. Since ours is old, we just accepted it, but I think it would be upsetting for a new house. Lastly, after only 4 days of using the dishwasher, the fixing part at the end of the second-tier rail came off, as shown in the picture. I wondered what was wrong. I managed to put it back on with pliers, but it isn't very sturdy. They only checked for cosmetic defects during installation. Please inspect thoroughly. Still, it is an appliance where the advantages feel far greater than the disadvantages. It has made things so much easier, so I am satisfied. Dishwasher Lady, I hope you have a great time!

Sentence (English): Still, it is an appliance where the advantages feel far greater than the disadvantages.
Comments (English): My hand suddenly started hurting, so I hurriedly bought a dishwasher. I had initially paid for a 6-place setting model, but my husband told me to get a bigger one since I was buying one anyway, so I quickly canceled that and bought this model without doing much research or finding any reviews. The result is satisfying. The exterior is stylish and pretty; it's a beige-pink tone and blends well with my white sink. It lacks steam and hot air drying functions, but the temperature is high enough to crush a plastic water bottle from Daiso. The technician said it is between 50 and 80 degrees. With the high-temperature drying function and the automatic door opening feature, it dries about 90%—only the water pooled at the top of cups doesn't dry completely. If you touch them a bit after it finishes, they dry completely. As for washing, the dishes came out sparkling clean. It even cleans the frying pan I used to grill pork belly well. After doing some research on dishwashers after purchasing it, I learned that the cleaning power of modern dishwashers depends on the detergent. I tried various cycles, and since the 1-hour cycle plus high-temperature drying takes about the same amount of time as the powerful cycle, I end up using the powerful or automatic cycles. I've tried the 1-hour cycle without drying plus an extra rinse, but personally, I dislike the dripping water, so I only use it when I'm in a hurry. I run the top-loading quick wash in the morning and the powerful cycle fully loaded in the evening, so I run it twice a day. I really love that it has the top-loading quick wash course. Also, I was surprised by how much there was to wash in the evening; I realized my hands and wrists have been under constant abuse all this time. My husband saw me pre-washing and asked if I really had to go to such lengths to put the dishes in, asking what good that does, but it helps a lot! I used to cut fruit for him and then do the dishes, but now we can sit down and eat fruit together! It's so good. That said, it's not without its downsides. I bought this in a hurry after comparing it to a 6-person model, so I assumed a cutlery holder was standard, but it turns out there is a 3-tier one. The cutlery holder is too big, takes up a lot of space, and is a bit inconvenient, so I ended up not using it. However, if I place the cutlery and utensils between the dishes so they don't fall through or get caught, it cleans really well. If you sell a smaller cutlery holder, I would be willing to buy it, but the 3-tier design is a bit disappointing. Also, if the sink needs to be cut during installation, you shouldn't expect a high-quality finish. Since ours is old, we just accepted it, but I think it would be upsetting for a new house. Lastly, after only 4 days of using the dishwasher, the fixing part at the end of the second-tier rail came off, as shown in the picture. I wondered what was wrong. I managed to put it back on with pliers, but it isn't very sturdy. They only checked for cosmetic defects during installation. Please inspect thoroughly. Still, it is an appliance where the advantages feel far greater than the disadvantages. It has made things so much easier, so I am satisfied. Dishwasher Lady, I hope you have a great time!

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is sleek and attractive and has a decent capacity.
Comments (English): [ Do Not Purchase ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is sleek and attractive and has a decent capacity. Unfortunately, it creates just as much work as hand washing my dishes, which I've been doing for the last 6 years while I saved for a kitchen renovation. So imagine my disappointment and confusion when I opened the door after using it for the first time to find it SOPPING WET on the interior! I had to wipe every surface down, spin both water wheels to get the water out, and keep the door and racks opened to make sure it did not mildew. Looking at the owner's manual I saw that the Light setting did not include dry time so I thought, ok, maybe that's the issue: there isn't a dry cycle on this setting. So I used the Heavy setting. Same thing: absolutely sopping wet on the inside. I then assumed it was malfunctioning and called the GE Service line to schedule a repair. After holding for over 30 minutes I was told this is a condensate model, meaning the dishes are dried by the water being pulled away from them to the other surfaces in the appliance, supposedly as an energy-saving feature. Too late to return it, so I'm stuck with this thing. Fortunately I won't have to use it that often because I don't generate a lot of dirty dishes, but I'm beyond annoyed to have spent over $700 on an appliance that I hate, and if I can spare others from this fate I'll at least have done a good deed,

It arrived perfectly with no scratches or dents. The packaging is very well thought out, and also the styrofoam on the bottom makes it easy to slide the dishwasher across your floor without scratching it. I did want to take a moment to mention a few things that are different. First of all, the dishwasher has a power cord, not a built in electrical junction box like our Samsung did. Lowes does sell the Bosch hard wire kit, but after reading some reviews on here about it almost burning people's houses down, I decided to go ahead and install and outlet under the counter and plug the dishwasher in using the INCLUDED power cord (we actually got 2 for some reason in the box). Second, the hose that connects to your disposal is a bit short, unless your cabinet is right next to your sink you will most likely need to get the Bosch extension kit. If, for some reason you already have the dishwasher and are trying to install it and are reading this review, there is a company called Fernco that makes a 3/4" PVC flexible coupler that fits onto the connector on the drain hose of the Bosch dishwasher and then fits onto the standard hose that comes with most airgaps, so I was able to finish my install up and not have to wait for the Bosch extension kit. Do yourself a favor and just order the kit. You can always return it if not needed. Aside from that, install was a breeze, it takes a bit of patience to level the feet on the dishwasher, but do yourself a favor and make sure you level it so everything works efficiently. One easy tip, check to make sure your counter is level, then if so, look at the gap between the dishwasher and counter on both sides, is it exactly the same? If not, then you need to adjust the feet to level it. The owners manual recommends no more than a 1/4" gap between the top of the dishwasher and the counter, which is typically enough to run your pinky finger through. The wifi connection is a royal pain, I still don't have it working. It picked up my fiber optic modem and not my home wifi network, and there was no way to change it. When I cancelled out, I never got the app on my phone to find the dishwasher again. I'm sure I'll get it working eventually.The dishwasher is so quiet you barely know it's running. Looking forward to having clean dishes again, our Samsung did not.

Sentence (English): After having a baby, I hated doing the dishes and it was so hard.
Comments (English): [ It's neat and pretty ] || ---------------- || After having a baby, I hated doing the dishes and it was so hard. As a working mom, I hated preparing my own meals, but then I realized it was incredibly difficult to wash them afterward. My husband and I would often argue over who should do the dishes. I struggled to juggle household chores, childcare, and work without a dishwasher until I finally bought my own house and was able to customize the layout, so I got a dishwasher. Since I'm not home on weekdays, I scheduled a Saturday delivery. The sink remodeler came that Saturday. He was very kind and, thanks to him, I realized the move-in cleaners hadn't cleaned the underside of the sink at all. He cleaned it as much as he could before leaving, which I was so grateful for. I really liked the sink remodeler. This is my first time using this dishwasher, and I've never used a different one before. I'm not sure if it's good or bad, but I'll probably use it again in a month. But let me leave a review after using it for the first time. The model number that was delivered is different from the one I'm selling. Is it just me? The sales number for the Satin White DW60B5095WUS is . But the installed one is DW60B5095GU. What the heck? And when I got married, I purchased all my appliances from the Samsung Bespoke line, so I ordered a Bespoke dishwasher this time. This 2021 model doesn't support Samsung SmartThings! I didn't realize it when I bought it. I assumed it would work, but it's surprising that some models don't support the Bespoke line. I don't usually use SmartThings, but it's still disappointing. When I first pressed the button, the dishwasher ran for over an hour on standard mode. Yesterday, I didn't have many dishes, so it ran for an hour. It felt like a waste of electricity and water. I turned off the drying function, and it was down to 50 minutes. I thought it might be like the Theta dishwashers these days, where the weight is measured to determine the appropriate time. It turns out each cycle has a set time. As with other reviews, there's no way to tell what happens after the dishwasher door closes or how many minutes are left. If you really want to know, you can do so while it's running. You can open the door to see, but water splashes out to the side and the machine automatically stops. It's not a lot, but if you want to know, you can open the door, see, and wipe the water away, right? That's why it's a bit inconvenient. I roughly rinsed it with water, put the frying pan in the dishwasher, and ran it. I tried it without the dryer function and without dishwasher rinse. It washed cleanly. I wasn't sure how to store it in the dishwasher, so I just crammed it in and ran it, and thankfully, it washed well. I guess I'll improve my storage skills with use. Ceramic dishes seem to dry well when dried, but plastic items like silicone or baby bottles don't dry well. Side dish bowls and concave areas also don't dry well. I'm not sure what the standard for pre-washing is, but I roughly rinsed the egg stuck to the frying pan with water, but it didn't wash off. I guess I need to wash it thoroughly before putting it back in. This is my first dishwasher, so please understand that I'm still in the process of getting used to it. I'll use it for another month or so and write another review to see if it was a good purchase.

Ceramic dishes seem to dry well when dried, but plastic items like silicone or baby bottles don't dry well. Side dish bowls and concave areas also don't dry well. I'm not sure what the standard for pre-washing is, but I roughly rinsed the egg stuck to the frying pan with water, but it didn't wash off. I guess I need to wash it thoroughly before putting it back in. This is my first dishwasher, so please understand that I'm still in the process of getting used to it. I'll use it for another month or so and write another review to see if it was a good purchase.

Ceramic dishes seem to dry well when dried, but plastic items like silicone or baby bottles don't dry well. Side dish bowls and concave areas also don't dry well. I'm not sure what the standard for pre-washing is, but I roughly rinsed the egg stuck to the frying pan with water, but it didn't wash off. I guess I need to wash it thoroughly before putting it back in. This is my first dishwasher, so please understand that I'm still in the process of getting used to it. I'll use it for another month or so and write another review to see if it was a good purchase.

I wasn't sure how to store it in the dishwasher, so I just crammed it in and ran it, and thankfully, it washed well. I guess I'll improve my storage skills with use. Ceramic dishes seem to dry well when dried, but plastic items like silicone or baby bottles don't dry well. Side dish bowls and concave areas also don't dry well. I'm not sure what the standard for pre-washing is, but I roughly rinsed the egg stuck to the frying pan with water, but it didn't wash off. I guess I need to wash it thoroughly before putting it back in. This is my first dishwasher, so please understand that I'm still in the process of getting used to it. I'll use it for another month or so and write another review to see if it was a good purchase.

I'll use it for another month or so and write another review to see if it was a good purchase.

Sentence (English): Bosch was said by most to be THE company for dishwashers, and the 800 series model as the "top of the line".
Comments (English): [ Good, but not great dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Bosch was said by most to be THE company for dishwashers, and the 800 series model as the "top of the line". After 3 months in my estimation it's tad bit over-hyped. My wife and I purchased as part of a major kitchen remodel earlier this year and selected the Bosch 800 to replace our 6 year old Kitchen Aid that had performed without issues. Firstly, one aspect that was definitely not overhyped was how quiet it is. It definitely is hard to know when it's running. The less impressive aspects are the rack layout and overall lack of quality in the materials used. As an engineer, I appreciate how products are designed for ergonomics and ease of use, and frankly this layout has me scratching my head in frustration at times. Placement of taller objects such as water bottles or wine glasses is challenging, and the adjustable shelves on the top rack are more of a nuisance. On the plus side I have grown quite accustomed to the separate silverware tray. This does come with a tradeoff in the limited height for taller items previously mentioned. In general it does a very capable job of getting items clean- I would score it as a 9 out of 10, but not significantly better than the solid performance of our middle-of-the-road former D/W. Also while I understand the lack of a printed version of the owner's manual with the unit, the digital versions are more confusing then necessary. I've been having difficulty figuring out what some of the indicator lights blinking at me recently even mean. Why not simply make a manual available in .pdf format for reference/ download? Overall a very solid product that could easily be better.

My wife and I purchased as part of a major kitchen remodel earlier this year and selected the Bosch 800 to replace our 6 year old Kitchen Aid that had performed without issues. Firstly, one aspect that was definitely not overhyped was how quiet it is. It definitely is hard to know when it's running. The less impressive aspects are the rack layout and overall lack of quality in the materials used. As an engineer, I appreciate how products are designed for ergonomics and ease of use, and frankly this layout has me scratching my head in frustration at times. Placement of taller objects such as water bottles or wine glasses is challenging, and the adjustable shelves on the top rack are more of a nuisance. On the plus side I have grown quite accustomed to the separate silverware tray. This does come with a tradeoff in the limited height for taller items previously mentioned. In general it does a very capable job of getting items clean- I would score it as a 9 out of 10, but not significantly better than the solid performance of our middle-of-the-road former D/W. Also while I understand the lack of a printed version of the owner's manual with the unit, the digital versions are more confusing then necessary. I've been having difficulty figuring out what some of the indicator lights blinking at me recently even mean. Why not simply make a manual available in .pdf format for reference/ download? Overall a very solid product that could easily be better.

Et comme c’est la chaleur accumulées dans le métal de la cuve et dans la vaisselle lors du lavage qui permet de sécher la vaisselle, cela signifie que plus il y a d’articles en plastique, moins il y a de chaleur pour sécher toute la vaisselle. Comments (English): [ Disappointing ] || ---------------- || After several weeks of trying different ways to use this dishwasher, I have come to the conclusion that there are several faults which are very disappointing. First of all, you should know that there is no heating element for drying dishes. This makes it difficult for anything made of plastic to dry. And since it is the heat accumulated in the metal of the tub and in the dishes during washing that allows the dishes to dry, this means that the more plastic items there are, the less heat there is to dry everything. the dishes. You should therefore plan to only put a few pieces of plastic at a time otherwise you will have to wipe a large part of the dishes. The second major drawback of this device is that it is completely airtight. So, if you leave it closed with dirty dishes (even well rinsed), foul odors inevitably develop. You should therefore always have an object, for example a towel, to prevent the door from closing. You must also put this object back in place each time you close the door. Likewise, as the tank is airtight, drying is more difficult since the humidity remains in the tank. So I plan each time to slightly open the door at the end of drying to let the humidity out in the form of steam. This involves being present and remembering to do so. If you don't do this, many items won't dry at all. I also wonder about the robustness of the lower baskets. The positive points of this dishwasher are its impeccable washing and its very quiet operation. Previous models had a much better plate configuration in the bottom rack and much more flexibility with prongs that could be adjusted flat. What can I say? Sentence (English): After several weeks of trying different ways to use this dishwasher, I have come to the conclusion that there are several defects that are very disappointing.
Comments (English): [ Disappointing ] || ---------------- || After several weeks of trying different ways to use this dishwasher, I have come to the conclusion that there are several defects that are very disappointing. First of all, you should know that there is no heating element for drying dishes. This makes it difficult for anything made of plastic to dry. And since it is the heat accumulated in the metal of the tub and in the dishes during washing that allows the dishes to dry, this means that the more plastic items there are, the less heat there is to dry everything. the dishes. You should therefore plan to only put a few pieces of plastic at a time otherwise you will have to wipe a large part of the dishes. The second major drawback of this device is that it is completely airtight. So if you leave it closed with dirty dishes (even well rinsed), foul odors inevitably develop. You should therefore always have an object, for example a towel, to prevent the door from closing completely. You must also put this object back in place each time you close the door. Likewise, as the tank is airtight, drying is more difficult since the humidity remains in the tank. So I plan each time to slightly open the door at the end of drying to let the humidity out in the form of steam. If you don't do this, anything made of plastic won't dry. even after several hours because moisture remains in the dishwasher. I also wonder about the robustness of the 2 lower baskets. The picks that are supposed to hold the dishes are all diagonally in the bottom rack. This makes positioning items sometimes difficult. Of course, it is possible to fold down the picks, but then lighter items will turn over during washing under the power of the jets. The positive points of this dishwasher are its impeccable washing and its quiet operation. That's still not enough to like this appliance since I have to dry a lot of the dishes by hand. not to mention the magnetic rag (my personal addition) to never forget to avoid odors
Comments (Original): [ Décevant ] || ---------------- || Après plusieurs semaines à tenter différentes façons d’utiliser ce lave-vaisselle, j’en viens à la conclusion qu’il y a plusieurs défauts qui sont très décevants. Tout d’abord, il faut savoir qu’il n’y a pas d’élément chauffant pour le séchage de la vaisselle. Cela fait en sorte que tout ce qui est en plastique sèche difficilement. Et comme c’est la chaleur accumulées dans le métal de la cuve et dans la vaisselle lors du lavage qui permet de sécher la vaisselle, cela signifie que plus il y a d’articles en plastique, moins il y a de chaleur pour sécher toute la vaisselle. Il faut donc prévoir ne mettre que quelques de plastique à la fois sinon on doit essuyer une grande partie de la vaisselle. Le deuxième grand défaut de cet appareil, c’est qu’il est complètement hermétique. Ainsi si vous le laissez fermé avec de la vaisselle sale (même bien rincée), inévitablement des odeurs nauséabondes se développent. Il faut donc toujours prévoir un objet, par exemple une serviette, pour empêcher que la porte se ferme complètement. Il faut aussi remettre cet objet en place chaque fois que vous refermez la porte. De même, comme la cuve est hermétique, le séchage est plus difficile puisque l’humidité reste dans la cuve. Je prévois donc chaque fois d’entrouvrir la porte de la fin du séchage pour faire sortir l’humidité sous forme de vapeur. Si on ne le fait pas, tout ce qui est en plastique ne sèche pas.. même après plusieurs heures car l'humidité reste dans le lave-vaisselle. Je me questionne également sur la robustesse des 2 paniers inférieurs. Les pics qui sont censés retenir la vaisselle sont tous en diagonale dans le panier du bas. Ça fait rend le positionnement des articles parfois difficile. Bien sûr, il est possible de rabattre les pics, mais alors les articles moins lourds se retournent durant le lavage sous la puissance des jets. Les points positifs de ce que lave-vaisselle sont son lavage impeccable et son fonctionnement silencieux. Ça demeure insuffisant pour aimer cet appareil puisque je dois essuyer une bonne partie de la vaisselle à la main... sans parler de la guenille aimantée (mon ajout personnel) à ne jamais oublier pour éviter les odeurs

Sentence (English): Worst appliance purchase I have ever made.
Comments (English): [ We got a lemon that caused water damage! ] || ---------------- || Worst appliance purchase I have ever made. It arrived on time, and it looked perfect. Installed per instructions and started its first cycle with no dishes. That's where everything went wrong. All of sudden we heard some strange noises. Then water started gushing from the bottom of the dishwasher. It never shut it self-down and when I stopped the cycle and hit auto drain that didn't work. Water kept coming. After mopping up all the water, I unhooked it and pulled it out and flipped it over so I could see the bottom. The Diverter Valve Motor was blown right out, and it was hanging by its wiring. Come to find out the mounting screws that were supposed to hold it in were nowhere to be found. They were never installed at the assembly plant. This was confirmed by the service tech that Whirlpool set out to repair it. It was nonrepairable. It turns out that the leak detection function didn't work because the water never made it to the leak tray with the float in it. Poor design if you ask me. Needless to say, the water damage was bad. The kitchen floor lifted and warped beyond repair. It also ran down to our finished basement and ruined multiple ceiling tiles. Whirlpool rep told me to make a claim with my homeowners' insurance. Haha. I did submit a claim to Whirlpool. Still waiting on a reply.

Sentence (English): This little guy is so good!
Comments (English): [ As good as it gets! ] || ---------------- || This little guy is so good! I have now installed multiple dishwashers into multiple apartments, and this little one is pretty much near the top. For a small, junior one bedroom, it's perfect. The spacing of the prongs allows for plates of up to 11", cereal bowls, large coffee mugs, pint glasses, ramekins, even some large mixing bowls, and those horribly shaped "blates" (bowl-plates that are great to eat everything out of, but impossible to stack into dishwashers). The utensil holder also maximizes utility with dedicated slots for 30+ utensils! Everything has come out perfectly clean, whether I use the express or normal cycle. And, it is so quiet. I love also that it auto-opens once it's finished, so if I need to head off on weeks' long travel, I just set it and forget it. There's no risk of mildewing "clean" plates that didn't fully dry in the dishwasher. Honestly, I have owned this dishwasher now for nearly 4 years, and have absolutely no complaints! If you're on the fence, this dishwasher is definitely a good one!

Sentence (English): We come from a large family, and it has been over 10 years since I got married, but only now have I finally bought a dishwasher.
Comments (English): We come from a large family, and it has been over 10 years since I got married, but only now have I finally bought a dishwasher. I felt that doing the dishes by hand didn't feel unsanitary. Also, since we had a goal of setting family rules to do the housework, I hadn't really given a dishwasher much thought. But in the end, all the housework always fell to me. I have a side job and am preparing to start my own business, and the constantly piling-up dishes felt like they were blocking my path, so I got annoyed and decided to buy one. It is easy to operate, comes with a water tank for self-installation, and includes an extra hose, so it is great that I can choose the installation method I prefer. When it arrived and I opened the package, the box was designed to be easy to take out. I brought the box home, opened it right next to where I wanted to install it, and set it up! The black color is sleek and pretty. I was originally going to buy the cheaper, smaller 2-3 person model, but I'm glad I didn't. The 6-person model is bigger than I expected, and while a bigger one would be nice for a large family, this one fits our sink size perfectly. I ran it before leaving for work in the morning, and when I came back, the door had opened automatically and the dishes were neatly dried. I don't have any dishes piled up today, and it's so great to save time since I don't have to stay glued to the kitchen. I'll make good use of this.

I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Product name Samsung Electronics dishwasher built-in real stainless steel Size 12 people Color Silver Material Stainless steel Design - Freestanding/built-in compatible - Front button operation (touch X) - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment O) - Spoon basket O - Interior (tub) material Stainless steel - Butyl soundproofing material (asphalt X) Function - Automatic door opening O - Powerful drying O (hot air drying X) - Reservation function O - Additional rinse O - Sterilization function O - Steam soaking O - Internal washing course O - Child protection function O Installation process Purchase Specify desired delivery date (check KakaoTalk) Specify sink reform date Specify visit of reform technician and installation date of reform dishwasher (check KakaoTalk) The total installation time is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, you can remodel on the same day and install it in the afternoon! Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. Comments (Original): [ 저렴한 가격에 꼭 필요한 기능이 다 있는 식세기 이모 ] || ---------------- || /이사 계획이 있으신 분 /전세 집이신 분 /복잡한 기능이 필요없는 부모님 댁에 설치해드릴 분 /식구가 적으신 분 /기본기능에 충실하며 가성비 제품을 찾으시는 분  이런 분들께 적극 추천하고 싶은 삼성 식세기 후기 써봅니다.  저는 1번에 해당하는...당장은 아니지만 1~2년내 이사 계획이 있는 구매자입니다. 기존에 6인용 식세기를 쓰고 있다가 고장나는 바람에 어쩔 수 없이 구매하게 되었는데요~ 얼마 쓰지 못하고 이 집에 두고 가야하기 때문에...  SK, LG, 삼성중에서 저렴한 모델을 보고 있었는데, 이 모델을 고른 이유는 다음과 같아요.  1. 미친 가성비.  (초초초 핫딜로 샀어요. 제가 구매한 가격은 40만원 초반입니다.)  2. 싱크대 장공사 비용이 저렴함 (저희집 싱크대가 비규격장에 싱크볼 아래있는 장을 줄이고 보강까지 해야하는 어려운 설치 환경이었고 공사비는 제각각이었는데 삼성이 가장 저렴했어요. 규격장이라면 모든 브랜드가 무료.)  ● 제품명 삼성전자 식기세척기 빌트인 리얼 스테인리스  ● 사이즈 12인용  ● 색상 실버  ● 재질 스테인리스  ● 디자인 - 프리스탠딩/ 빌트인 겸용 - 전면 버튼식 조작 (터치X) - 2단 식기 바구니 (높이 조절 O) - 수저 바구니 O - 내부(터브) 소재 스테인리스 - 부틸 차음재 (아스콘 X)  ● 기능 - 자동 문열림 O - 강력 건조 O (열풍건조 X) - 예약 기능 O - 헹굼 추가 O - 살균 기능 O - 스팀 불림 O - 내부 세척코스 O -어린이 보호기능 O  ● 설치 과정 구매 → 희망배송일 지정(카톡 확인) → 싱크대 리폼일 지정 → 리폼기사님 방문 및 리폼 → 식세기 설치일 지정(카톡 확인) → 식세기 설치  총 필요 기간 2일이지만, 미리 협의하면 당일 오전 리폼하고 오후 설치도 가능하기도 하대요!  ● 총평 이사 계획이 전혀 없었다면 아마도 더 상위 모델을 골랐을 것 같기는 합니다. 하지만,  이 모델이 기능적으로 딸려서라기 보다는 키친핏이 아니라는 것(걸레받이를 자름)과 12인용이라는 것 때문이예요. 그 만큼 6인용 가격에 빌트인까지 되는 큰 식세기라니 만족에 만족 만족입니다.  특히, 3단 모델이랑 비교했을 때 호불호가 있긴 하겠으나 이 제품은 상단 바구니를 최대로 올리고 하단에 냄비, 후라이팬은 물론이고 김치통까지 들어가니까 저는 3단보다 훨씬 쓸모가 있다고 생각이 들었어요.  그리고 조작부 디자인이 좀 옛(?)스러워서 아쉬었는데 쓰다보니 물 묻은 손이나 고무장갑 끼고 터치 조작하는거 잘 안될 때 극혐인데, 이 제품은 버튼식인 것도 너무 마음에 듭니다. 부모님들께서 쓰시기에도  훨씬 좋을 것 같아요.  싱크대 장도 개인적으로 알아봤을 땐, 사진처럼 싱크볼 아래 장을 줄여야하니 못해주신다고 2군데서나 그랬었는데 삼성에서 보내주신 기사님은 보시고 바로 OK해주셨고, 비규격장 비용에 상판 보강비만 추가되서 저렴하게 했어요. 친절하게 해주시고, 마지막엔 설거지에서 해방되시라고 웃으며 가셨는데... 덕분에 해방되어 감사했습니다.  세척기능은 요새 제품 다 잘되겠지만 이전에 6인용을 SK제품을 썼었는데,  개인적으로는 이 제품이 더 잘되는 것 같구요. 문열림 건조로도 물방울 자국 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조도 잘됩니다.  세척력과 건조력이 마음에 안드실 땐 세제를 바꿔보시거나,  린스를 추가로 쓰시면 뽀득뽀득 뽀송뽀송 잘되니까 참고해보세요.  ● 추천 및 재구매 의사 ★★★★★  ↓ 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 눌러주세요 :D

(초초초 핫딜로 샀어요. 제가 구매한 가격은 40만원 초반입니다.)  2. 싱크대 장공사 비용이 저렴함 (저희집 싱크대가 비규격장에 싱크볼 아래있는 장을 줄이고 보강까지 해야하는 어려운 설치 환경이었고 공사비는 제각각이었는데 삼성이 가장 저렴했어요. 규격장이라면 모든 브랜드가 무료.)  ● 제품명 삼성전자 식기세척기 빌트인 리얼 스테인리스  ● 사이즈 12인용  ● 색상 실버  ● 재질 스테인리스  ● 디자인 - 프리스탠딩/ 빌트인 겸용 - 전면 버튼식 조작 (터치X) - 2단 식기 바구니 (높이 조절 O) - 수저 바구니 O - 내부(터브) 소재 스테인리스 - 부틸 차음재 (아스콘 X)  ● 기능 - 자동 문열림 O - 강력 건조 O (열풍건조 X) - 예약 기능 O - 헹굼 추가 O - 살균 기능 O - 스팀 불림 O - 내부 세척코스 O -어린이 보호기능 O  ● 설치 과정 구매 → 희망배송일 지정(카톡 확인) → 싱크대 리폼일 지정 → 리폼기사님 방문 및 리폼 → 식세기 설치일 지정(카톡 확인) → 식세기 설치  총 필요 기간 2일이지만, 미리 협의하면 당일 오전 리폼하고 오후 설치도 가능하기도 하대요!  ● 총평 이사 계획이 전혀 없었다면 아마도 더 상위 모델을 골랐을 것 같기는 합니다. 하지만,  이 모델이 기능적으로 딸려서라기 보다는 키친핏이 아니라는 것(걸레받이를 자름)과 12인용이라는 것 때문이예요. 그 만큼 6인용 가격에 빌트인까지 되는 큰 식세기라니 만족에 만족 만족입니다.  특히, 3단 모델이랑 비교했을 때 호불호가 있긴 하겠으나 이 제품은 상단 바구니를 최대로 올리고 하단에 냄비, 후라이팬은 물론이고 김치통까지 들어가니까 저는 3단보다 훨씬 쓸모가 있다고 생각이 들었어요.  그리고 조작부 디자인이 좀 옛(?)스러워서 아쉬었는데 쓰다보니 물 묻은 손이나 고무장갑 끼고 터치 조작하는거 잘 안될 때 극혐인데, 이 제품은 버튼식인 것도 너무 마음에 듭니다. 부모님들께서 쓰시기에도  훨씬 좋을 것 같아요.  싱크대 장도 개인적으로 알아봤을 땐, 사진처럼 싱크볼 아래 장을 줄여야하니 못해주신다고 2군데서나 그랬었는데 삼성에서 보내주신 기사님은 보시고 바로 OK해주셨고, 비규격장 비용에 상판 보강비만 추가되서 저렴하게 했어요. 친절하게 해주시고, 마지막엔 설거지에서 해방되시라고 웃으며 가셨는데... 덕분에 해방되어 감사했습니다.  세척기능은 요새 제품 다 잘되겠지만 이전에 6인용을 SK제품을 썼었는데,  개인적으로는 이 제품이 더 잘되는 것 같구요. 문열림 건조로도 물방울 자국 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조도 잘됩니다.  세척력과 건조력이 마음에 안드실 땐 세제를 바꿔보시거나,  린스를 추가로 쓰시면 뽀득뽀득 뽀송뽀송 잘되니까 참고해보세요.  ● 추천 및 재구매 의사 ★★★★★  ↓ 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 눌러주세요 :D

Sentence (English): I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher with all the essential features at an affordable price ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move /People who are renting /People who want to install it at their parents' house where complicated functions are not needed /People with a small family /People who are looking for a cost-effective product that is faithful to the basic functions. I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Product name Samsung Electronics dishwasher built-in real stainless steel Size 12 people Color Silver Material Stainless steel Design - Freestanding/built-in compatible - Front button operation (touch X) - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment O) - Spoon basket O - Interior (tub) material Stainless steel - Butyl soundproofing material (asphalt X) Function - Automatic door opening O - Powerful drying O (hot air drying X) - Reservation function O - Additional rinse O - Sterilization function O - Steam soaking O - Internal washing course O - Child protection function O Installation process Purchase Specify desired delivery date (check KakaoTalk) Specify sink reform date Specify visit of reform technician and installation date of reform dishwasher (check KakaoTalk) The total installation time is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, you can remodel on the same day and install it in the afternoon! Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. Recommendation and repurchase intention If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D
