(초초초 핫딜로 샀어요. 제가 구매한 가격은 40만원 초반입니다.)  2. 싱크대 장공사 비용이 저렴함 (저희집 싱크대가 비규격장에 싱크볼 아래있는 장을 줄이고 보강까지 해야하는 어려운 설치 환경이었고 공사비는 제각각이었는데 삼성이 가장 저렴했어요. 규격장이라면 모든 브랜드가 무료.)  ● 제품명 삼성전자 식기세척기 빌트인 리얼 스테인리스  ● 사이즈 12인용  ● 색상 실버  ● 재질 스테인리스  ● 디자인 - 프리스탠딩/ 빌트인 겸용 - 전면 버튼식 조작 (터치X) - 2단 식기 바구니 (높이 조절 O) - 수저 바구니 O - 내부(터브) 소재 스테인리스 - 부틸 차음재 (아스콘 X)  ● 기능 - 자동 문열림 O - 강력 건조 O (열풍건조 X) - 예약 기능 O - 헹굼 추가 O - 살균 기능 O - 스팀 불림 O - 내부 세척코스 O -어린이 보호기능 O  ● 설치 과정 구매 → 희망배송일 지정(카톡 확인) → 싱크대 리폼일 지정 → 리폼기사님 방문 및 리폼 → 식세기 설치일 지정(카톡 확인) → 식세기 설치  총 필요 기간 2일이지만, 미리 협의하면 당일 오전 리폼하고 오후 설치도 가능하기도 하대요!  ● 총평 이사 계획이 전혀 없었다면 아마도 더 상위 모델을 골랐을 것 같기는 합니다. 하지만,  이 모델이 기능적으로 딸려서라기 보다는 키친핏이 아니라는 것(걸레받이를 자름)과 12인용이라는 것 때문이예요. 그 만큼 6인용 가격에 빌트인까지 되는 큰 식세기라니 만족에 만족 만족입니다.  특히, 3단 모델이랑 비교했을 때 호불호가 있긴 하겠으나 이 제품은 상단 바구니를 최대로 올리고 하단에 냄비, 후라이팬은 물론이고 김치통까지 들어가니까 저는 3단보다 훨씬 쓸모가 있다고 생각이 들었어요.  그리고 조작부 디자인이 좀 옛(?)스러워서 아쉬었는데 쓰다보니 물 묻은 손이나 고무장갑 끼고 터치 조작하는거 잘 안될 때 극혐인데, 이 제품은 버튼식인 것도 너무 마음에 듭니다. 부모님들께서 쓰시기에도  훨씬 좋을 것 같아요.  싱크대 장도 개인적으로 알아봤을 땐, 사진처럼 싱크볼 아래 장을 줄여야하니 못해주신다고 2군데서나 그랬었는데 삼성에서 보내주신 기사님은 보시고 바로 OK해주셨고, 비규격장 비용에 상판 보강비만 추가되서 저렴하게 했어요. 친절하게 해주시고, 마지막엔 설거지에서 해방되시라고 웃으며 가셨는데... 덕분에 해방되어 감사했습니다.  세척기능은 요새 제품 다 잘되겠지만 이전에 6인용을 SK제품을 썼었는데,  개인적으로는 이 제품이 더 잘되는 것 같구요. 문열림 건조로도 물방울 자국 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조도 잘됩니다.  세척력과 건조력이 마음에 안드실 땐 세제를 바꿔보시거나,  린스를 추가로 쓰시면 뽀득뽀득 뽀송뽀송 잘되니까 참고해보세요.  ● 추천 및 재구매 의사 ★★★★★  ↓ 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 눌러주세요 :D

Sentence (English): I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher with all the essential features at an affordable price ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move /People who are renting /People who want to install it at their parents' house where complicated functions are not needed /People with a small family /People who are looking for a cost-effective product that is faithful to the basic functions. I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Product name Samsung Electronics dishwasher built-in real stainless steel Size 12 people Color Silver Material Stainless steel Design - Freestanding/built-in compatible - Front button operation (touch X) - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment O) - Spoon basket O - Interior (tub) material Stainless steel - Butyl soundproofing material (asphalt X) Function - Automatic door opening O - Powerful drying O (hot air drying X) - Reservation function O - Additional rinse O - Sterilization function O - Steam soaking O - Internal washing course O - Child protection function O Installation process Purchase Specify desired delivery date (check KakaoTalk) Specify sink reform date Specify visit of reform technician and installation date of reform dishwasher (check KakaoTalk) The total installation time is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, you can remodel on the same day and install it in the afternoon! Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. Recommendation and repurchase intention If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

(초초초 핫딜로 샀어요. 제가 구매한 가격은 40만원 초반입니다.)  2. 싱크대 장공사 비용이 저렴함 (저희집 싱크대가 비규격장에 싱크볼 아래있는 장을 줄이고 보강까지 해야하는 어려운 설치 환경이었고 공사비는 제각각이었는데 삼성이 가장 저렴했어요. 규격장이라면 모든 브랜드가 무료.)  ● 제품명 삼성전자 식기세척기 빌트인 리얼 스테인리스  ● 사이즈 12인용  ● 색상 실버  ● 재질 스테인리스  ● 디자인 - 프리스탠딩/ 빌트인 겸용 - 전면 버튼식 조작 (터치X) - 2단 식기 바구니 (높이 조절 O) - 수저 바구니 O - 내부(터브) 소재 스테인리스 - 부틸 차음재 (아스콘 X)  ● 기능 - 자동 문열림 O - 강력 건조 O (열풍건조 X) - 예약 기능 O - 헹굼 추가 O - 살균 기능 O - 스팀 불림 O - 내부 세척코스 O -어린이 보호기능 O  ● 설치 과정 구매 → 희망배송일 지정(카톡 확인) → 싱크대 리폼일 지정 → 리폼기사님 방문 및 리폼 → 식세기 설치일 지정(카톡 확인) → 식세기 설치  총 필요 기간 2일이지만, 미리 협의하면 당일 오전 리폼하고 오후 설치도 가능하기도 하대요!  ● 총평 이사 계획이 전혀 없었다면 아마도 더 상위 모델을 골랐을 것 같기는 합니다. 하지만,  이 모델이 기능적으로 딸려서라기 보다는 키친핏이 아니라는 것(걸레받이를 자름)과 12인용이라는 것 때문이예요. 그 만큼 6인용 가격에 빌트인까지 되는 큰 식세기라니 만족에 만족 만족입니다.  특히, 3단 모델이랑 비교했을 때 호불호가 있긴 하겠으나 이 제품은 상단 바구니를 최대로 올리고 하단에 냄비, 후라이팬은 물론이고 김치통까지 들어가니까 저는 3단보다 훨씬 쓸모가 있다고 생각이 들었어요.  그리고 조작부 디자인이 좀 옛(?)스러워서 아쉬었는데 쓰다보니 물 묻은 손이나 고무장갑 끼고 터치 조작하는거 잘 안될 때 극혐인데, 이 제품은 버튼식인 것도 너무 마음에 듭니다. 부모님들께서 쓰시기에도  훨씬 좋을 것 같아요.  싱크대 장도 개인적으로 알아봤을 땐, 사진처럼 싱크볼 아래 장을 줄여야하니 못해주신다고 2군데서나 그랬었는데 삼성에서 보내주신 기사님은 보시고 바로 OK해주셨고, 비규격장 비용에 상판 보강비만 추가되서 저렴하게 했어요. 친절하게 해주시고, 마지막엔 설거지에서 해방되시라고 웃으며 가셨는데... 덕분에 해방되어 감사했습니다.  세척기능은 요새 제품 다 잘되겠지만 이전에 6인용을 SK제품을 썼었는데,  개인적으로는 이 제품이 더 잘되는 것 같구요. 문열림 건조로도 물방울 자국 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조도 잘됩니다.  세척력과 건조력이 마음에 안드실 땐 세제를 바꿔보시거나,  린스를 추가로 쓰시면 뽀득뽀득 뽀송뽀송 잘되니까 참고해보세요.  ● 추천 및 재구매 의사 ★★★★★  ↓ 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 눌러주세요 :D

Sentence (English): I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher with all the essential features at an affordable price ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move /People who are renting /People who want to install it at their parents' house where complicated functions are not needed /People with a small family /People who are looking for a cost-effective product that is faithful to the basic functions. I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Product name Samsung Electronics dishwasher built-in real stainless steel Size 12 people Color Silver Material Stainless steel Design - Freestanding/built-in compatible - Front button operation (touch X) - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment O) - Spoon basket O - Interior (tub) material Stainless steel - Butyl soundproofing material (asphalt X) Function - Automatic door opening O - Powerful drying O (hot air drying X) - Reservation function O - Additional rinse O - Sterilization function O - Steam soaking O - Internal washing course O - Child protection function O Installation process Purchase Specify desired delivery date (check KakaoTalk) Specify sink reform date Specify visit of reform technician and installation date of reform dishwasher (check KakaoTalk) The total installation time is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, you can remodel on the same day and install it in the afternoon! Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. Recommendation and repurchase intention If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Product name Samsung Electronics dishwasher built-in real stainless steel Size 12 people Color Silver Material Stainless steel Design - Freestanding/built-in compatible - Front button operation (touch X) - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment O) - Spoon basket O - Interior (tub) material Stainless steel - Butyl soundproofing material (asphalt X) Function - Automatic door opening O - Powerful drying O (hot air drying X) - Reservation function O - Additional rinse O - Sterilization function O - Steam soaking O - Internal washing course O - Child protection function O Installation process Purchase Specify desired delivery date (check KakaoTalk) Specify sink reform date Specify visit of reform technician and installation date of reform dishwasher (check KakaoTalk) The total installation time is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, you can remodel on the same day and install it in the afternoon! Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. Recommendation and repurchase intention If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

(초초초 핫딜로 샀어요. 제가 구매한 가격은 40만원 초반입니다.)  2. 싱크대 장공사 비용이 저렴함 (저희집 싱크대가 비규격장에 싱크볼 아래있는 장을 줄이고 보강까지 해야하는 어려운 설치 환경이었고 공사비는 제각각이었는데 삼성이 가장 저렴했어요. 규격장이라면 모든 브랜드가 무료.)  ● 제품명 삼성전자 식기세척기 빌트인 리얼 스테인리스  ● 사이즈 12인용  ● 색상 실버  ● 재질 스테인리스  ● 디자인 - 프리스탠딩/ 빌트인 겸용 - 전면 버튼식 조작 (터치X) - 2단 식기 바구니 (높이 조절 O) - 수저 바구니 O - 내부(터브) 소재 스테인리스 - 부틸 차음재 (아스콘 X)  ● 기능 - 자동 문열림 O - 강력 건조 O (열풍건조 X) - 예약 기능 O - 헹굼 추가 O - 살균 기능 O - 스팀 불림 O - 내부 세척코스 O -어린이 보호기능 O  ● 설치 과정 구매 → 희망배송일 지정(카톡 확인) → 싱크대 리폼일 지정 → 리폼기사님 방문 및 리폼 → 식세기 설치일 지정(카톡 확인) → 식세기 설치  총 필요 기간 2일이지만, 미리 협의하면 당일 오전 리폼하고 오후 설치도 가능하기도 하대요!  ● 총평 이사 계획이 전혀 없었다면 아마도 더 상위 모델을 골랐을 것 같기는 합니다. 하지만,  이 모델이 기능적으로 딸려서라기 보다는 키친핏이 아니라는 것(걸레받이를 자름)과 12인용이라는 것 때문이예요. 그 만큼 6인용 가격에 빌트인까지 되는 큰 식세기라니 만족에 만족 만족입니다.  특히, 3단 모델이랑 비교했을 때 호불호가 있긴 하겠으나 이 제품은 상단 바구니를 최대로 올리고 하단에 냄비, 후라이팬은 물론이고 김치통까지 들어가니까 저는 3단보다 훨씬 쓸모가 있다고 생각이 들었어요.  그리고 조작부 디자인이 좀 옛(?)스러워서 아쉬었는데 쓰다보니 물 묻은 손이나 고무장갑 끼고 터치 조작하는거 잘 안될 때 극혐인데, 이 제품은 버튼식인 것도 너무 마음에 듭니다. 부모님들께서 쓰시기에도  훨씬 좋을 것 같아요.  싱크대 장도 개인적으로 알아봤을 땐, 사진처럼 싱크볼 아래 장을 줄여야하니 못해주신다고 2군데서나 그랬었는데 삼성에서 보내주신 기사님은 보시고 바로 OK해주셨고, 비규격장 비용에 상판 보강비만 추가되서 저렴하게 했어요. 친절하게 해주시고, 마지막엔 설거지에서 해방되시라고 웃으며 가셨는데... 덕분에 해방되어 감사했습니다.  세척기능은 요새 제품 다 잘되겠지만 이전에 6인용을 SK제품을 썼었는데,  개인적으로는 이 제품이 더 잘되는 것 같구요. 문열림 건조로도 물방울 자국 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조도 잘됩니다.  세척력과 건조력이 마음에 안드실 땐 세제를 바꿔보시거나,  린스를 추가로 쓰시면 뽀득뽀득 뽀송뽀송 잘되니까 참고해보세요.  ● 추천 및 재구매 의사 ★★★★★  ↓ 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 눌러주세요 :D

Comments (English): [ A dishwasher with all the essential features at an affordable price ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move /People who are renting /People who want to install it at their parents' house where complicated functions are not needed /People with a small family /People who are looking for a cost-effective product that is faithful to the basic functions. I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Product name Samsung Electronics dishwasher built-in real stainless steel Size 12 people Color Silver Material Stainless steel Design - Freestanding/built-in compatible - Front button operation (touch X) - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment O) - Spoon basket O - Interior (tub) material Stainless steel - Butyl soundproofing material (asphalt X) Function - Automatic door opening O - Powerful drying O (hot air drying X) - Reservation function O - Additional rinse O - Sterilization function O - Steam soaking O - Internal washing course O - Child protection function O Installation process Purchase Specify desired delivery date (check KakaoTalk) Specify sink reform date Specify visit of reform technician and installation date of reform dishwasher (check KakaoTalk) The total installation time is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, you can remodel on the same day and install it in the afternoon! Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. Recommendation and repurchase intention If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. (초초초 핫딜로 샀어요. 제가 구매한 가격은 40만원 초반입니다.)  2. 싱크대 장공사 비용이 저렴함 (저희집 싱크대가 비규격장에 싱크볼 아래있는 장을 줄이고 보강까지 해야하는 어려운 설치 환경이었고 공사비는 제각각이었는데 삼성이 가장 저렴했어요. 규격장이라면 모든 브랜드가 무료.)  ● 제품명 삼성전자 식기세척기 빌트인 리얼 스테인리스  ● 사이즈 12인용  ● 색상 실버  ● 재질 스테인리스  ● 디자인 - 프리스탠딩/ 빌트인 겸용 - 전면 버튼식 조작 (터치X) - 2단 식기 바구니 (높이 조절 O) - 수저 바구니 O - 내부(터브) 소재 스테인리스 - 부틸 차음재 (아스콘 X)  ● 기능 - 자동 문열림 O - 강력 건조 O (열풍건조 X) - 예약 기능 O - 헹굼 추가 O - 살균 기능 O - 스팀 불림 O - 내부 세척코스 O -어린이 보호기능 O  ● 설치 과정 구매 → 희망배송일 지정(카톡 확인) → 싱크대 리폼일 지정 → 리폼기사님 방문 및 리폼 → 식세기 설치일 지정(카톡 확인) → 식세기 설치  총 필요 기간 2일이지만, 미리 협의하면 당일 오전 리폼하고 오후 설치도 가능하기도 하대요!  ● 총평 이사 계획이 전혀 없었다면 아마도 더 상위 모델을 골랐을 것 같기는 합니다. 하지만,  이 모델이 기능적으로 딸려서라기 보다는 키친핏이 아니라는 것(걸레받이를 자름)과 12인용이라는 것 때문이예요. 그 만큼 6인용 가격에 빌트인까지 되는 큰 식세기라니 만족에 만족 만족입니다.  특히, 3단 모델이랑 비교했을 때 호불호가 있긴 하겠으나 이 제품은 상단 바구니를 최대로 올리고 하단에 냄비, 후라이팬은 물론이고 김치통까지 들어가니까 저는 3단보다 훨씬 쓸모가 있다고 생각이 들었어요.  그리고 조작부 디자인이 좀 옛(?)스러워서 아쉬었는데 쓰다보니 물 묻은 손이나 고무장갑 끼고 터치 조작하는거 잘 안될 때 극혐인데, 이 제품은 버튼식인 것도 너무 마음에 듭니다. 부모님들께서 쓰시기에도  훨씬 좋을 것 같아요.  싱크대 장도 개인적으로 알아봤을 땐, 사진처럼 싱크볼 아래 장을 줄여야하니 못해주신다고 2군데서나 그랬었는데 삼성에서 보내주신 기사님은 보시고 바로 OK해주셨고, 비규격장 비용에 상판 보강비만 추가되서 저렴하게 했어요. 친절하게 해주시고, 마지막엔 설거지에서 해방되시라고 웃으며 가셨는데... 덕분에 해방되어 감사했습니다.  세척기능은 요새 제품 다 잘되겠지만 이전에 6인용을 SK제품을 썼었는데,  개인적으로는 이 제품이 더 잘되는 것 같구요. 문열림 건조로도 물방울 자국 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조도 잘됩니다.  세척력과 건조력이 마음에 안드실 땐 세제를 바꿔보시거나,  린스를 추가로 쓰시면 뽀득뽀득 뽀송뽀송 잘되니까 참고해보세요.  ● 추천 및 재구매 의사 ★★★★★  ↓ 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 눌러주세요 :D

Sentence (English): The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher with all the essential features at an affordable price ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move /People who are renting /People who want to install it at their parents' house where complicated functions are not needed /People with a small family /People who are looking for a cost-effective product that is faithful to the basic functions. I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Product name Samsung Electronics dishwasher built-in real stainless steel Size 12 people Color Silver Material Stainless steel Design - Freestanding/built-in compatible - Front button operation (touch X) - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment O) - Spoon basket O - Interior (tub) material Stainless steel - Butyl soundproofing material (asphalt X) Function - Automatic door opening O - Powerful drying O (hot air drying X) - Reservation function O - Additional rinse O - Sterilization function O - Steam soaking O - Internal washing course O - Child protection function O Installation process Purchase Specify desired delivery date (check KakaoTalk) Specify sink reform date Specify visit of reform technician and installation date of reform dishwasher (check KakaoTalk) The total installation time is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, you can remodel on the same day and install it in the afternoon! Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. Recommendation and repurchase intention If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

(초초초 핫딜로 샀어요. 제가 구매한 가격은 40만원 초반입니다.)  2. 싱크대 장공사 비용이 저렴함 (저희집 싱크대가 비규격장에 싱크볼 아래있는 장을 줄이고 보강까지 해야하는 어려운 설치 환경이었고 공사비는 제각각이었는데 삼성이 가장 저렴했어요. 규격장이라면 모든 브랜드가 무료.)  ● 제품명 삼성전자 식기세척기 빌트인 리얼 스테인리스  ● 사이즈 12인용  ● 색상 실버  ● 재질 스테인리스  ● 디자인 - 프리스탠딩/ 빌트인 겸용 - 전면 버튼식 조작 (터치X) - 2단 식기 바구니 (높이 조절 O) - 수저 바구니 O - 내부(터브) 소재 스테인리스 - 부틸 차음재 (아스콘 X)  ● 기능 - 자동 문열림 O - 강력 건조 O (열풍건조 X) - 예약 기능 O - 헹굼 추가 O - 살균 기능 O - 스팀 불림 O - 내부 세척코스 O -어린이 보호기능 O  ● 설치 과정 구매 → 희망배송일 지정(카톡 확인) → 싱크대 리폼일 지정 → 리폼기사님 방문 및 리폼 → 식세기 설치일 지정(카톡 확인) → 식세기 설치  총 필요 기간 2일이지만, 미리 협의하면 당일 오전 리폼하고 오후 설치도 가능하기도 하대요!  ● 총평 이사 계획이 전혀 없었다면 아마도 더 상위 모델을 골랐을 것 같기는 합니다. 하지만,  이 모델이 기능적으로 딸려서라기 보다는 키친핏이 아니라는 것(걸레받이를 자름)과 12인용이라는 것 때문이예요. 그 만큼 6인용 가격에 빌트인까지 되는 큰 식세기라니 만족에 만족 만족입니다.  특히, 3단 모델이랑 비교했을 때 호불호가 있긴 하겠으나 이 제품은 상단 바구니를 최대로 올리고 하단에 냄비, 후라이팬은 물론이고 김치통까지 들어가니까 저는 3단보다 훨씬 쓸모가 있다고 생각이 들었어요.  그리고 조작부 디자인이 좀 옛(?)스러워서 아쉬었는데 쓰다보니 물 묻은 손이나 고무장갑 끼고 터치 조작하는거 잘 안될 때 극혐인데, 이 제품은 버튼식인 것도 너무 마음에 듭니다. 부모님들께서 쓰시기에도  훨씬 좋을 것 같아요.  싱크대 장도 개인적으로 알아봤을 땐, 사진처럼 싱크볼 아래 장을 줄여야하니 못해주신다고 2군데서나 그랬었는데 삼성에서 보내주신 기사님은 보시고 바로 OK해주셨고, 비규격장 비용에 상판 보강비만 추가되서 저렴하게 했어요. 친절하게 해주시고, 마지막엔 설거지에서 해방되시라고 웃으며 가셨는데... 덕분에 해방되어 감사했습니다.  세척기능은 요새 제품 다 잘되겠지만 이전에 6인용을 SK제품을 썼었는데,  개인적으로는 이 제품이 더 잘되는 것 같구요. 문열림 건조로도 물방울 자국 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조도 잘됩니다.  세척력과 건조력이 마음에 안드실 땐 세제를 바꿔보시거나,  린스를 추가로 쓰시면 뽀득뽀득 뽀송뽀송 잘되니까 참고해보세요.  ● 추천 및 재구매 의사 ★★★★★  ↓ 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 눌러주세요 :D

I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. (초초초 핫딜로 샀어요. 제가 구매한 가격은 40만원 초반입니다.)  2. 싱크대 장공사 비용이 저렴함 (저희집 싱크대가 비규격장에 싱크볼 아래있는 장을 줄이고 보강까지 해야하는 어려운 설치 환경이었고 공사비는 제각각이었는데 삼성이 가장 저렴했어요. 규격장이라면 모든 브랜드가 무료.)  ● 제품명 삼성전자 식기세척기 빌트인 리얼 스테인리스  ● 사이즈 12인용  ● 색상 실버  ● 재질 스테인리스  ● 디자인 - 프리스탠딩/ 빌트인 겸용 - 전면 버튼식 조작 (터치X) - 2단 식기 바구니 (높이 조절 O) - 수저 바구니 O - 내부(터브) 소재 스테인리스 - 부틸 차음재 (아스콘 X)  ● 기능 - 자동 문열림 O - 강력 건조 O (열풍건조 X) - 예약 기능 O - 헹굼 추가 O - 살균 기능 O - 스팀 불림 O - 내부 세척코스 O -어린이 보호기능 O  ● 설치 과정 구매 → 희망배송일 지정(카톡 확인) → 싱크대 리폼일 지정 → 리폼기사님 방문 및 리폼 → 식세기 설치일 지정(카톡 확인) → 식세기 설치  총 필요 기간 2일이지만, 미리 협의하면 당일 오전 리폼하고 오후 설치도 가능하기도 하대요!  ● 총평 이사 계획이 전혀 없었다면 아마도 더 상위 모델을 골랐을 것 같기는 합니다. 하지만,  이 모델이 기능적으로 딸려서라기 보다는 키친핏이 아니라는 것(걸레받이를 자름)과 12인용이라는 것 때문이예요. 그 만큼 6인용 가격에 빌트인까지 되는 큰 식세기라니 만족에 만족 만족입니다.  특히, 3단 모델이랑 비교했을 때 호불호가 있긴 하겠으나 이 제품은 상단 바구니를 최대로 올리고 하단에 냄비, 후라이팬은 물론이고 김치통까지 들어가니까 저는 3단보다 훨씬 쓸모가 있다고 생각이 들었어요.  그리고 조작부 디자인이 좀 옛(?)스러워서 아쉬었는데 쓰다보니 물 묻은 손이나 고무장갑 끼고 터치 조작하는거 잘 안될 때 극혐인데, 이 제품은 버튼식인 것도 너무 마음에 듭니다. 부모님들께서 쓰시기에도  훨씬 좋을 것 같아요.  싱크대 장도 개인적으로 알아봤을 땐, 사진처럼 싱크볼 아래 장을 줄여야하니 못해주신다고 2군데서나 그랬었는데 삼성에서 보내주신 기사님은 보시고 바로 OK해주셨고, 비규격장 비용에 상판 보강비만 추가되서 저렴하게 했어요. 친절하게 해주시고, 마지막엔 설거지에서 해방되시라고 웃으며 가셨는데... 덕분에 해방되어 감사했습니다.  세척기능은 요새 제품 다 잘되겠지만 이전에 6인용을 SK제품을 썼었는데,  개인적으로는 이 제품이 더 잘되는 것 같구요. 문열림 건조로도 물방울 자국 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조도 잘됩니다.  세척력과 건조력이 마음에 안드실 땐 세제를 바꿔보시거나,  린스를 추가로 쓰시면 뽀득뽀득 뽀송뽀송 잘되니까 참고해보세요.  ● 추천 및 재구매 의사 ★★★★★  ↓ 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 눌러주세요 :D

I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. (초초초 핫딜로 샀어요. 제가 구매한 가격은 40만원 초반입니다.)  2. 싱크대 장공사 비용이 저렴함 (저희집 싱크대가 비규격장에 싱크볼 아래있는 장을 줄이고 보강까지 해야하는 어려운 설치 환경이었고 공사비는 제각각이었는데 삼성이 가장 저렴했어요. 규격장이라면 모든 브랜드가 무료.)  ● 제품명 삼성전자 식기세척기 빌트인 리얼 스테인리스  ● 사이즈 12인용  ● 색상 실버  ● 재질 스테인리스  ● 디자인 - 프리스탠딩/ 빌트인 겸용 - 전면 버튼식 조작 (터치X) - 2단 식기 바구니 (높이 조절 O) - 수저 바구니 O - 내부(터브) 소재 스테인리스 - 부틸 차음재 (아스콘 X)  ● 기능 - 자동 문열림 O - 강력 건조 O (열풍건조 X) - 예약 기능 O - 헹굼 추가 O - 살균 기능 O - 스팀 불림 O - 내부 세척코스 O -어린이 보호기능 O  ● 설치 과정 구매 → 희망배송일 지정(카톡 확인) → 싱크대 리폼일 지정 → 리폼기사님 방문 및 리폼 → 식세기 설치일 지정(카톡 확인) → 식세기 설치  총 필요 기간 2일이지만, 미리 협의하면 당일 오전 리폼하고 오후 설치도 가능하기도 하대요!  ● 총평 이사 계획이 전혀 없었다면 아마도 더 상위 모델을 골랐을 것 같기는 합니다. 하지만,  이 모델이 기능적으로 딸려서라기 보다는 키친핏이 아니라는 것(걸레받이를 자름)과 12인용이라는 것 때문이예요. 그 만큼 6인용 가격에 빌트인까지 되는 큰 식세기라니 만족에 만족 만족입니다.  특히, 3단 모델이랑 비교했을 때 호불호가 있긴 하겠으나 이 제품은 상단 바구니를 최대로 올리고 하단에 냄비, 후라이팬은 물론이고 김치통까지 들어가니까 저는 3단보다 훨씬 쓸모가 있다고 생각이 들었어요.  그리고 조작부 디자인이 좀 옛(?)스러워서 아쉬었는데 쓰다보니 물 묻은 손이나 고무장갑 끼고 터치 조작하는거 잘 안될 때 극혐인데, 이 제품은 버튼식인 것도 너무 마음에 듭니다. 부모님들께서 쓰시기에도  훨씬 좋을 것 같아요.  싱크대 장도 개인적으로 알아봤을 땐, 사진처럼 싱크볼 아래 장을 줄여야하니 못해주신다고 2군데서나 그랬었는데 삼성에서 보내주신 기사님은 보시고 바로 OK해주셨고, 비규격장 비용에 상판 보강비만 추가되서 저렴하게 했어요. 친절하게 해주시고, 마지막엔 설거지에서 해방되시라고 웃으며 가셨는데... 덕분에 해방되어 감사했습니다.  세척기능은 요새 제품 다 잘되겠지만 이전에 6인용을 SK제품을 썼었는데,  개인적으로는 이 제품이 더 잘되는 것 같구요. 문열림 건조로도 물방울 자국 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조도 잘됩니다.  세척력과 건조력이 마음에 안드실 땐 세제를 바꿔보시거나,  린스를 추가로 쓰시면 뽀득뽀득 뽀송뽀송 잘되니까 참고해보세요.  ● 추천 및 재구매 의사 ★★★★★  ↓ 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 눌러주세요 :D

Sentence (English): I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher with all the essential features at an affordable price ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move /People who are renting /People who want to install it at their parents' house where complicated functions are not needed /People with a small family /People who are looking for a cost-effective product that is faithful to the basic functions. I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Product name Samsung Electronics dishwasher built-in real stainless steel Size 12 people Color Silver Material Stainless steel Design - Freestanding/built-in compatible - Front button operation (touch X) - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment O) - Spoon basket O - Interior (tub) material Stainless steel - Butyl soundproofing material (asphalt X) Function - Automatic door opening O - Powerful drying O (hot air drying X) - Reservation function O - Additional rinse O - Sterilization function O - Steam soaking O - Internal washing course O - Child protection function O Installation process Purchase Specify desired delivery date (check KakaoTalk) Specify sink reform date Specify visit of reform technician and installation date of reform dishwasher (check KakaoTalk) The total installation time is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, you can remodel on the same day and install it in the afternoon! Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. Recommendation and repurchase intention If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

(초초초 핫딜로 샀어요. 제가 구매한 가격은 40만원 초반입니다.)  2. 싱크대 장공사 비용이 저렴함 (저희집 싱크대가 비규격장에 싱크볼 아래있는 장을 줄이고 보강까지 해야하는 어려운 설치 환경이었고 공사비는 제각각이었는데 삼성이 가장 저렴했어요. 규격장이라면 모든 브랜드가 무료.)  ● 제품명 삼성전자 식기세척기 빌트인 리얼 스테인리스  ● 사이즈 12인용  ● 색상 실버  ● 재질 스테인리스  ● 디자인 - 프리스탠딩/ 빌트인 겸용 - 전면 버튼식 조작 (터치X) - 2단 식기 바구니 (높이 조절 O) - 수저 바구니 O - 내부(터브) 소재 스테인리스 - 부틸 차음재 (아스콘 X)  ● 기능 - 자동 문열림 O - 강력 건조 O (열풍건조 X) - 예약 기능 O - 헹굼 추가 O - 살균 기능 O - 스팀 불림 O - 내부 세척코스 O -어린이 보호기능 O  ● 설치 과정 구매 → 희망배송일 지정(카톡 확인) → 싱크대 리폼일 지정 → 리폼기사님 방문 및 리폼 → 식세기 설치일 지정(카톡 확인) → 식세기 설치  총 필요 기간 2일이지만, 미리 협의하면 당일 오전 리폼하고 오후 설치도 가능하기도 하대요!  ● 총평 이사 계획이 전혀 없었다면 아마도 더 상위 모델을 골랐을 것 같기는 합니다. 하지만,  이 모델이 기능적으로 딸려서라기 보다는 키친핏이 아니라는 것(걸레받이를 자름)과 12인용이라는 것 때문이예요. 그 만큼 6인용 가격에 빌트인까지 되는 큰 식세기라니 만족에 만족 만족입니다.  특히, 3단 모델이랑 비교했을 때 호불호가 있긴 하겠으나 이 제품은 상단 바구니를 최대로 올리고 하단에 냄비, 후라이팬은 물론이고 김치통까지 들어가니까 저는 3단보다 훨씬 쓸모가 있다고 생각이 들었어요.  그리고 조작부 디자인이 좀 옛(?)스러워서 아쉬었는데 쓰다보니 물 묻은 손이나 고무장갑 끼고 터치 조작하는거 잘 안될 때 극혐인데, 이 제품은 버튼식인 것도 너무 마음에 듭니다. 부모님들께서 쓰시기에도  훨씬 좋을 것 같아요.  싱크대 장도 개인적으로 알아봤을 땐, 사진처럼 싱크볼 아래 장을 줄여야하니 못해주신다고 2군데서나 그랬었는데 삼성에서 보내주신 기사님은 보시고 바로 OK해주셨고, 비규격장 비용에 상판 보강비만 추가되서 저렴하게 했어요. 친절하게 해주시고, 마지막엔 설거지에서 해방되시라고 웃으며 가셨는데... 덕분에 해방되어 감사했습니다.  세척기능은 요새 제품 다 잘되겠지만 이전에 6인용을 SK제품을 썼었는데,  개인적으로는 이 제품이 더 잘되는 것 같구요. 문열림 건조로도 물방울 자국 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조도 잘됩니다.  세척력과 건조력이 마음에 안드실 땐 세제를 바꿔보시거나,  린스를 추가로 쓰시면 뽀득뽀득 뽀송뽀송 잘되니까 참고해보세요.  ● 추천 및 재구매 의사 ★★★★★  ↓ 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 눌러주세요 :D

Comments (English): [ A dishwasher with all the essential features at an affordable price ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move /People who are renting /People who want to install it at their parents' house where complicated functions are not needed /People with a small family /People who are looking for a cost-effective product that is faithful to the basic functions. I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Product name Samsung Electronics dishwasher built-in real stainless steel Size 12 people Color Silver Material Stainless steel Design - Freestanding/built-in compatible - Front button operation (touch X) - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment O) - Spoon basket O - Interior (tub) material Stainless steel - Butyl soundproofing material (asphalt X) Function - Automatic door opening O - Powerful drying O (hot air drying X) - Reservation function O - Additional rinse O - Sterilization function O - Steam soaking O - Internal washing course O - Child protection function O Installation process Purchase Specify desired delivery date (check KakaoTalk) Specify sink reform date Specify visit of reform technician and installation date of reform dishwasher (check KakaoTalk) The total installation time is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, you can remodel on the same day and install it in the afternoon! Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. Recommendation and repurchase intention If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

(초초초 핫딜로 샀어요. 제가 구매한 가격은 40만원 초반입니다.)  2. 싱크대 장공사 비용이 저렴함 (저희집 싱크대가 비규격장에 싱크볼 아래있는 장을 줄이고 보강까지 해야하는 어려운 설치 환경이었고 공사비는 제각각이었는데 삼성이 가장 저렴했어요. 규격장이라면 모든 브랜드가 무료.)  ● 제품명 삼성전자 식기세척기 빌트인 리얼 스테인리스  ● 사이즈 12인용  ● 색상 실버  ● 재질 스테인리스  ● 디자인 - 프리스탠딩/ 빌트인 겸용 - 전면 버튼식 조작 (터치X) - 2단 식기 바구니 (높이 조절 O) - 수저 바구니 O - 내부(터브) 소재 스테인리스 - 부틸 차음재 (아스콘 X)  ● 기능 - 자동 문열림 O - 강력 건조 O (열풍건조 X) - 예약 기능 O - 헹굼 추가 O - 살균 기능 O - 스팀 불림 O - 내부 세척코스 O -어린이 보호기능 O  ● 설치 과정 구매 → 희망배송일 지정(카톡 확인) → 싱크대 리폼일 지정 → 리폼기사님 방문 및 리폼 → 식세기 설치일 지정(카톡 확인) → 식세기 설치  총 필요 기간 2일이지만, 미리 협의하면 당일 오전 리폼하고 오후 설치도 가능하기도 하대요!  ● 총평 이사 계획이 전혀 없었다면 아마도 더 상위 모델을 골랐을 것 같기는 합니다. 하지만,  이 모델이 기능적으로 딸려서라기 보다는 키친핏이 아니라는 것(걸레받이를 자름)과 12인용이라는 것 때문이예요. 그 만큼 6인용 가격에 빌트인까지 되는 큰 식세기라니 만족에 만족 만족입니다.  특히, 3단 모델이랑 비교했을 때 호불호가 있긴 하겠으나 이 제품은 상단 바구니를 최대로 올리고 하단에 냄비, 후라이팬은 물론이고 김치통까지 들어가니까 저는 3단보다 훨씬 쓸모가 있다고 생각이 들었어요.  그리고 조작부 디자인이 좀 옛(?)스러워서 아쉬었는데 쓰다보니 물 묻은 손이나 고무장갑 끼고 터치 조작하는거 잘 안될 때 극혐인데, 이 제품은 버튼식인 것도 너무 마음에 듭니다. 부모님들께서 쓰시기에도  훨씬 좋을 것 같아요.  싱크대 장도 개인적으로 알아봤을 땐, 사진처럼 싱크볼 아래 장을 줄여야하니 못해주신다고 2군데서나 그랬었는데 삼성에서 보내주신 기사님은 보시고 바로 OK해주셨고, 비규격장 비용에 상판 보강비만 추가되서 저렴하게 했어요. 친절하게 해주시고, 마지막엔 설거지에서 해방되시라고 웃으며 가셨는데... 덕분에 해방되어 감사했습니다.  세척기능은 요새 제품 다 잘되겠지만 이전에 6인용을 SK제품을 썼었는데,  개인적으로는 이 제품이 더 잘되는 것 같구요. 문열림 건조로도 물방울 자국 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조도 잘됩니다.  세척력과 건조력이 마음에 안드실 땐 세제를 바꿔보시거나,  린스를 추가로 쓰시면 뽀득뽀득 뽀송뽀송 잘되니까 참고해보세요.  ● 추천 및 재구매 의사 ★★★★★  ↓ 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 눌러주세요 :D

Comments (English): [ A dishwasher with all the essential features at an affordable price ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move /People who are renting /People who want to install it at their parents' house where complicated functions are not needed /People with a small family /People who are looking for a cost-effective product that is faithful to the basic functions. I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Product name Samsung Electronics dishwasher built-in real stainless steel Size 12 people Color Silver Material Stainless steel Design - Freestanding/built-in compatible - Front button operation (touch X) - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment O) - Spoon basket O - Interior (tub) material Stainless steel - Butyl soundproofing material (asphalt X) Function - Automatic door opening O - Powerful drying O (hot air drying X) - Reservation function O - Additional rinse O - Sterilization function O - Steam soaking O - Internal washing course O - Child protection function O Installation process Purchase Specify desired delivery date (check KakaoTalk) Specify sink reform date Specify visit of reform technician and installation date of reform dishwasher (check KakaoTalk) The total installation time is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, you can remodel on the same day and install it in the afternoon! Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. Recommendation and repurchase intention If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

(초초초 핫딜로 샀어요. 제가 구매한 가격은 40만원 초반입니다.)  2. 싱크대 장공사 비용이 저렴함 (저희집 싱크대가 비규격장에 싱크볼 아래있는 장을 줄이고 보강까지 해야하는 어려운 설치 환경이었고 공사비는 제각각이었는데 삼성이 가장 저렴했어요. 규격장이라면 모든 브랜드가 무료.)  ● 제품명 삼성전자 식기세척기 빌트인 리얼 스테인리스  ● 사이즈 12인용  ● 색상 실버  ● 재질 스테인리스  ● 디자인 - 프리스탠딩/ 빌트인 겸용 - 전면 버튼식 조작 (터치X) - 2단 식기 바구니 (높이 조절 O) - 수저 바구니 O - 내부(터브) 소재 스테인리스 - 부틸 차음재 (아스콘 X)  ● 기능 - 자동 문열림 O - 강력 건조 O (열풍건조 X) - 예약 기능 O - 헹굼 추가 O - 살균 기능 O - 스팀 불림 O - 내부 세척코스 O -어린이 보호기능 O  ● 설치 과정 구매 → 희망배송일 지정(카톡 확인) → 싱크대 리폼일 지정 → 리폼기사님 방문 및 리폼 → 식세기 설치일 지정(카톡 확인) → 식세기 설치  총 필요 기간 2일이지만, 미리 협의하면 당일 오전 리폼하고 오후 설치도 가능하기도 하대요!  ● 총평 이사 계획이 전혀 없었다면 아마도 더 상위 모델을 골랐을 것 같기는 합니다. 하지만,  이 모델이 기능적으로 딸려서라기 보다는 키친핏이 아니라는 것(걸레받이를 자름)과 12인용이라는 것 때문이예요. 그 만큼 6인용 가격에 빌트인까지 되는 큰 식세기라니 만족에 만족 만족입니다.  특히, 3단 모델이랑 비교했을 때 호불호가 있긴 하겠으나 이 제품은 상단 바구니를 최대로 올리고 하단에 냄비, 후라이팬은 물론이고 김치통까지 들어가니까 저는 3단보다 훨씬 쓸모가 있다고 생각이 들었어요.  그리고 조작부 디자인이 좀 옛(?)스러워서 아쉬었는데 쓰다보니 물 묻은 손이나 고무장갑 끼고 터치 조작하는거 잘 안될 때 극혐인데, 이 제품은 버튼식인 것도 너무 마음에 듭니다. 부모님들께서 쓰시기에도  훨씬 좋을 것 같아요.  싱크대 장도 개인적으로 알아봤을 땐, 사진처럼 싱크볼 아래 장을 줄여야하니 못해주신다고 2군데서나 그랬었는데 삼성에서 보내주신 기사님은 보시고 바로 OK해주셨고, 비규격장 비용에 상판 보강비만 추가되서 저렴하게 했어요. 친절하게 해주시고, 마지막엔 설거지에서 해방되시라고 웃으며 가셨는데... 덕분에 해방되어 감사했습니다.  세척기능은 요새 제품 다 잘되겠지만 이전에 6인용을 SK제품을 썼었는데,  개인적으로는 이 제품이 더 잘되는 것 같구요. 문열림 건조로도 물방울 자국 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조도 잘됩니다.  세척력과 건조력이 마음에 안드실 땐 세제를 바꿔보시거나,  린스를 추가로 쓰시면 뽀득뽀득 뽀송뽀송 잘되니까 참고해보세요.  ● 추천 및 재구매 의사 ★★★★★  ↓ 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 눌러주세요 :D

I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Product name Samsung Electronics dishwasher built-in real stainless steel Size 12 people Color Silver Material Stainless steel Design - Freestanding/built-in compatible - Front button operation (touch X) - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment O) - Spoon basket O - Interior (tub) material Stainless steel - Butyl soundproofing material (asphalt X) Function - Automatic door opening O - Powerful drying O (hot air drying X) - Reservation function O - Additional rinse O - Sterilization function O - Steam soaking O - Internal washing course O - Child protection function O Installation process Purchase Specify desired delivery date (check KakaoTalk) Specify sink reform date Specify visit of reform technician and installation date of reform dishwasher (check KakaoTalk) The total installation time is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, you can remodel on the same day and install it in the afternoon! Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. (초초초 핫딜로 샀어요. 제가 구매한 가격은 40만원 초반입니다.)  2. 싱크대 장공사 비용이 저렴함 (저희집 싱크대가 비규격장에 싱크볼 아래있는 장을 줄이고 보강까지 해야하는 어려운 설치 환경이었고 공사비는 제각각이었는데 삼성이 가장 저렴했어요. 규격장이라면 모든 브랜드가 무료.)  ● 제품명 삼성전자 식기세척기 빌트인 리얼 스테인리스  ● 사이즈 12인용  ● 색상 실버  ● 재질 스테인리스  ● 디자인 - 프리스탠딩/ 빌트인 겸용 - 전면 버튼식 조작 (터치X) - 2단 식기 바구니 (높이 조절 O) - 수저 바구니 O - 내부(터브) 소재 스테인리스 - 부틸 차음재 (아스콘 X)  ● 기능 - 자동 문열림 O - 강력 건조 O (열풍건조 X) - 예약 기능 O - 헹굼 추가 O - 살균 기능 O - 스팀 불림 O - 내부 세척코스 O -어린이 보호기능 O  ● 설치 과정 구매 → 희망배송일 지정(카톡 확인) → 싱크대 리폼일 지정 → 리폼기사님 방문 및 리폼 → 식세기 설치일 지정(카톡 확인) → 식세기 설치  총 필요 기간 2일이지만, 미리 협의하면 당일 오전 리폼하고 오후 설치도 가능하기도 하대요!  ● 총평 이사 계획이 전혀 없었다면 아마도 더 상위 모델을 골랐을 것 같기는 합니다. 하지만,  이 모델이 기능적으로 딸려서라기 보다는 키친핏이 아니라는 것(걸레받이를 자름)과 12인용이라는 것 때문이예요. 그 만큼 6인용 가격에 빌트인까지 되는 큰 식세기라니 만족에 만족 만족입니다.  특히, 3단 모델이랑 비교했을 때 호불호가 있긴 하겠으나 이 제품은 상단 바구니를 최대로 올리고 하단에 냄비, 후라이팬은 물론이고 김치통까지 들어가니까 저는 3단보다 훨씬 쓸모가 있다고 생각이 들었어요.  그리고 조작부 디자인이 좀 옛(?)스러워서 아쉬었는데 쓰다보니 물 묻은 손이나 고무장갑 끼고 터치 조작하는거 잘 안될 때 극혐인데, 이 제품은 버튼식인 것도 너무 마음에 듭니다. 부모님들께서 쓰시기에도  훨씬 좋을 것 같아요.  싱크대 장도 개인적으로 알아봤을 땐, 사진처럼 싱크볼 아래 장을 줄여야하니 못해주신다고 2군데서나 그랬었는데 삼성에서 보내주신 기사님은 보시고 바로 OK해주셨고, 비규격장 비용에 상판 보강비만 추가되서 저렴하게 했어요. 친절하게 해주시고, 마지막엔 설거지에서 해방되시라고 웃으며 가셨는데... 덕분에 해방되어 감사했습니다.  세척기능은 요새 제품 다 잘되겠지만 이전에 6인용을 SK제품을 썼었는데,  개인적으로는 이 제품이 더 잘되는 것 같구요. 문열림 건조로도 물방울 자국 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조도 잘됩니다.  세척력과 건조력이 마음에 안드실 땐 세제를 바꿔보시거나,  린스를 추가로 쓰시면 뽀득뽀득 뽀송뽀송 잘되니까 참고해보세요.  ● 추천 및 재구매 의사 ★★★★★  ↓ 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 눌러주세요 :D

Comments (English): [ A dishwasher with all the essential features at an affordable price ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move /People who are renting /People who want to install it at their parents' house where complicated functions are not needed /People with a small family /People who are looking for a cost-effective product that is faithful to the basic functions. I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Product name Samsung Electronics dishwasher built-in real stainless steel Size 12 people Color Silver Material Stainless steel Design - Freestanding/built-in compatible - Front button operation (touch X) - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment O) - Spoon basket O - Interior (tub) material Stainless steel - Butyl soundproofing material (asphalt X) Function - Automatic door opening O - Powerful drying O (hot air drying X) - Reservation function O - Additional rinse O - Sterilization function O - Steam soaking O - Internal washing course O - Child protection function O Installation process Purchase Specify desired delivery date (check KakaoTalk) Specify sink reform date Specify visit of reform technician and installation date of reform dishwasher (check KakaoTalk) The total installation time is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, you can remodel on the same day and install it in the afternoon! Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. Recommendation and repurchase intention If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

(초초초 핫딜로 샀어요. 제가 구매한 가격은 40만원 초반입니다.)  2. 싱크대 장공사 비용이 저렴함 (저희집 싱크대가 비규격장에 싱크볼 아래있는 장을 줄이고 보강까지 해야하는 어려운 설치 환경이었고 공사비는 제각각이었는데 삼성이 가장 저렴했어요. 규격장이라면 모든 브랜드가 무료.)  ● 제품명 삼성전자 식기세척기 빌트인 리얼 스테인리스  ● 사이즈 12인용  ● 색상 실버  ● 재질 스테인리스  ● 디자인 - 프리스탠딩/ 빌트인 겸용 - 전면 버튼식 조작 (터치X) - 2단 식기 바구니 (높이 조절 O) - 수저 바구니 O - 내부(터브) 소재 스테인리스 - 부틸 차음재 (아스콘 X)  ● 기능 - 자동 문열림 O - 강력 건조 O (열풍건조 X) - 예약 기능 O - 헹굼 추가 O - 살균 기능 O - 스팀 불림 O - 내부 세척코스 O -어린이 보호기능 O  ● 설치 과정 구매 → 희망배송일 지정(카톡 확인) → 싱크대 리폼일 지정 → 리폼기사님 방문 및 리폼 → 식세기 설치일 지정(카톡 확인) → 식세기 설치  총 필요 기간 2일이지만, 미리 협의하면 당일 오전 리폼하고 오후 설치도 가능하기도 하대요!  ● 총평 이사 계획이 전혀 없었다면 아마도 더 상위 모델을 골랐을 것 같기는 합니다. 하지만,  이 모델이 기능적으로 딸려서라기 보다는 키친핏이 아니라는 것(걸레받이를 자름)과 12인용이라는 것 때문이예요. 그 만큼 6인용 가격에 빌트인까지 되는 큰 식세기라니 만족에 만족 만족입니다.  특히, 3단 모델이랑 비교했을 때 호불호가 있긴 하겠으나 이 제품은 상단 바구니를 최대로 올리고 하단에 냄비, 후라이팬은 물론이고 김치통까지 들어가니까 저는 3단보다 훨씬 쓸모가 있다고 생각이 들었어요.  그리고 조작부 디자인이 좀 옛(?)스러워서 아쉬었는데 쓰다보니 물 묻은 손이나 고무장갑 끼고 터치 조작하는거 잘 안될 때 극혐인데, 이 제품은 버튼식인 것도 너무 마음에 듭니다. 부모님들께서 쓰시기에도  훨씬 좋을 것 같아요.  싱크대 장도 개인적으로 알아봤을 땐, 사진처럼 싱크볼 아래 장을 줄여야하니 못해주신다고 2군데서나 그랬었는데 삼성에서 보내주신 기사님은 보시고 바로 OK해주셨고, 비규격장 비용에 상판 보강비만 추가되서 저렴하게 했어요. 친절하게 해주시고, 마지막엔 설거지에서 해방되시라고 웃으며 가셨는데... 덕분에 해방되어 감사했습니다.  세척기능은 요새 제품 다 잘되겠지만 이전에 6인용을 SK제품을 썼었는데,  개인적으로는 이 제품이 더 잘되는 것 같구요. 문열림 건조로도 물방울 자국 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조도 잘됩니다.  세척력과 건조력이 마음에 안드실 땐 세제를 바꿔보시거나,  린스를 추가로 쓰시면 뽀득뽀득 뽀송뽀송 잘되니까 참고해보세요.  ● 추천 및 재구매 의사 ★★★★★  ↓ 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 눌러주세요 :D

Sentence (English): The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher with all the essential features at an affordable price ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move /People who are renting /People who want to install it at their parents' house where complicated functions are not needed /People with a small family /People who are looking for a cost-effective product that is faithful to the basic functions. I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Product name Samsung Electronics dishwasher built-in real stainless steel Size 12 people Color Silver Material Stainless steel Design - Freestanding/built-in compatible - Front button operation (touch X) - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment O) - Spoon basket O - Interior (tub) material Stainless steel - Butyl soundproofing material (asphalt X) Function - Automatic door opening O - Powerful drying O (hot air drying X) - Reservation function O - Additional rinse O - Sterilization function O - Steam soaking O - Internal washing course O - Child protection function O Installation process Purchase Specify desired delivery date (check KakaoTalk) Specify sink reform date Specify visit of reform technician and installation date of reform dishwasher (check KakaoTalk) The total installation time is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, you can remodel on the same day and install it in the afternoon! Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. Recommendation and repurchase intention If this was helpful in your purchase, please click :D

(초초초 핫딜로 샀어요. 제가 구매한 가격은 40만원 초반입니다.)  2. 싱크대 장공사 비용이 저렴함 (저희집 싱크대가 비규격장에 싱크볼 아래있는 장을 줄이고 보강까지 해야하는 어려운 설치 환경이었고 공사비는 제각각이었는데 삼성이 가장 저렴했어요. 규격장이라면 모든 브랜드가 무료.)  ● 제품명 삼성전자 식기세척기 빌트인 리얼 스테인리스  ● 사이즈 12인용  ● 색상 실버  ● 재질 스테인리스  ● 디자인 - 프리스탠딩/ 빌트인 겸용 - 전면 버튼식 조작 (터치X) - 2단 식기 바구니 (높이 조절 O) - 수저 바구니 O - 내부(터브) 소재 스테인리스 - 부틸 차음재 (아스콘 X)  ● 기능 - 자동 문열림 O - 강력 건조 O (열풍건조 X) - 예약 기능 O - 헹굼 추가 O - 살균 기능 O - 스팀 불림 O - 내부 세척코스 O -어린이 보호기능 O  ● 설치 과정 구매 → 희망배송일 지정(카톡 확인) → 싱크대 리폼일 지정 → 리폼기사님 방문 및 리폼 → 식세기 설치일 지정(카톡 확인) → 식세기 설치  총 필요 기간 2일이지만, 미리 협의하면 당일 오전 리폼하고 오후 설치도 가능하기도 하대요!  ● 총평 이사 계획이 전혀 없었다면 아마도 더 상위 모델을 골랐을 것 같기는 합니다. 하지만,  이 모델이 기능적으로 딸려서라기 보다는 키친핏이 아니라는 것(걸레받이를 자름)과 12인용이라는 것 때문이예요. 그 만큼 6인용 가격에 빌트인까지 되는 큰 식세기라니 만족에 만족 만족입니다.  특히, 3단 모델이랑 비교했을 때 호불호가 있긴 하겠으나 이 제품은 상단 바구니를 최대로 올리고 하단에 냄비, 후라이팬은 물론이고 김치통까지 들어가니까 저는 3단보다 훨씬 쓸모가 있다고 생각이 들었어요.  그리고 조작부 디자인이 좀 옛(?)스러워서 아쉬었는데 쓰다보니 물 묻은 손이나 고무장갑 끼고 터치 조작하는거 잘 안될 때 극혐인데, 이 제품은 버튼식인 것도 너무 마음에 듭니다. 부모님들께서 쓰시기에도  훨씬 좋을 것 같아요.  싱크대 장도 개인적으로 알아봤을 땐, 사진처럼 싱크볼 아래 장을 줄여야하니 못해주신다고 2군데서나 그랬었는데 삼성에서 보내주신 기사님은 보시고 바로 OK해주셨고, 비규격장 비용에 상판 보강비만 추가되서 저렴하게 했어요. 친절하게 해주시고, 마지막엔 설거지에서 해방되시라고 웃으며 가셨는데... 덕분에 해방되어 감사했습니다.  세척기능은 요새 제품 다 잘되겠지만 이전에 6인용을 SK제품을 썼었는데,  개인적으로는 이 제품이 더 잘되는 것 같구요. 문열림 건조로도 물방울 자국 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조도 잘됩니다.  세척력과 건조력이 마음에 안드실 땐 세제를 바꿔보시거나,  린스를 추가로 쓰시면 뽀득뽀득 뽀송뽀송 잘되니까 참고해보세요.  ● 추천 및 재구매 의사 ★★★★★  ↓ 구매에 도움이 되셨다면 눌러주세요 :D

Sentence (English): If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher with all the essential features at an affordable price ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move /People who are renting /People who want to install it at their parents' house where complicated functions are not needed /People with a small family /People who are looking for a cost-effective product that is faithful to the basic functions. I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Product name Samsung Electronics dishwasher built-in real stainless steel Size 12 people Color Silver Material Stainless steel Design - Freestanding/built-in compatible - Front button operation (touch X) - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment O) - Spoon basket O - Interior (tub) material Stainless steel - Butyl soundproofing material (asphalt X) Function - Automatic door opening O - Powerful drying O (hot air drying X) - Reservation function O - Additional rinse O - Sterilization function O - Steam soaking O - Internal washing course O - Child protection function O Installation process Purchase Specify desired delivery date (check KakaoTalk) Specify sink reform date Specify visit of reform technician and installation date of reform dishwasher (check KakaoTalk) The total installation time is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, you can remodel on the same day and install it in the afternoon! Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it. Comments (English): [ A dishwasher with all the essential features at an affordable price ] || ---------------- || /People planning to move /People who are renting /People who want to install it at their parents' house where complicated functions are not needed /People with a small family /People who are looking for a cost-effective product that is faithful to the basic functions. I will write a review of a Samsung dishwasher that I would like to actively recommend to these people. I fall into the first category. I am a buyer who is planning to move within the next 1-2 years, although not right away. I had been using a 6-person dishwasher, but it broke down, so I had no choice but to buy it~ Since I will not be able to use it for long and will have to leave it in this house. I was looking at cheaper models among SK, LG, and Samsung, and I chose this model for the following reasons. 1. Crazy cost-effectiveness. (I bought it at a super hot deal. The price I bought it for was in the early 400,000 won range.) 2. The sink installation cost is low (My house's sink was a non-standard cabinet, so it was a difficult installation environment where I had to reduce the cabinet under the sink bowl and even reinforce it, and the installation cost varied, but Samsung was the cheapest. If it's a standard cabinet, all brands are free.) Product name Samsung Electronics dishwasher built-in real stainless steel Size 12 people Color Silver Material Stainless steel Design - Freestanding/built-in compatible - Front button operation (touch X) - 2-tier dish basket (height adjustment O) - Spoon basket O - Interior (tub) material Stainless steel - Butyl soundproofing material (asphalt X) Function - Automatic door opening O - Powerful drying O (hot air drying X) - Reservation function O - Additional rinse O - Sterilization function O - Steam soaking O - Internal washing course O - Child protection function O Installation process Purchase Specify desired delivery date (check KakaoTalk) Specify sink reform date Specify visit of reform technician and installation date of reform dishwasher (check KakaoTalk) The total installation time is 2 days, but if you negotiate in advance, you can remodel on the same day and install it in the afternoon! Overall review If I had no plans to move at all, I would have probably chosen a higher model. However, this model is not functionally inferior, but because it is not a kitchen fit (the mop holder is cut off) and it is for 12 people. I am very satisfied with the large dishwasher that is built-in for the price of 6 people. In particular, when compared to the 3-stage model, there may be likes and dislikes, but this product raises the upper basket to the maximum and can hold pots, frying pans, and even a kimchi container at the bottom, so I thought it was much more useful than the 3-stage model. And the design of the control panel was a bit old-fashioned(?), but as I used it, I hated it when I couldn't use the touch screen with wet hands or rubber gloves, but I really like the button type of this product. I think it would be much better for my parents to use. When I personally looked into the sink, two places said they couldn't do it because the cabinet under the sink bowl had to be reduced as in the photo, but the technician sent by Samsung gave the OK right away, and added only the cost of reinforcing the countertop to the cost of the non-standard cabinet, so it was cheap. They were kind, and in the end, they left with a smile, telling me to be free from washing dishes. Thanks to that, I was freed. The washing function is good for all the products these days, but I used to use a 6-person SK product, and I personally think this product works better. It dries well without a single water droplet even with the door open dryer. If you are not satisfied with the washing and drying power, try changing the detergent or using additional rinse, so it will be fluffy and soft, so please refer to it.
