Sentence (English): Let me tell you exactly why I will never shut up about this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Shamelessly obsessed with a dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Let me tell you exactly why I will never shut up about this dishwasher. We are brand new homeowners that moved in with a dishwasher that left much to be desired. Dishes had to be thoroughly cleaned before being loaded in the dishwasher for even the tiniest piece of food would still be stuck on the plate after a wash cycle. We toughed it out and practically hand washed each dish before running it through the dishwasher. Surely the dishwasher was doing something, right? But then. the orange stuff came. After each cycle our dishes were dripping in a mysterious orange liquid, leaving them dirtier than before we used the dishwasher. Now instead of handwashing them once, we were handwashing them twice and putting them through the dishwasher. Why would we put ourselves through this? Are we gluttons for punishment? Perhaps. But we just saw no other way. We began just handwashing most things and skipping the dish"washer" entirely but the time it took was ridiculous. My entire life we rinsed our dishes completely before putting them in the dishwasher so I had known no other way. That is. until we found the most loved appliance in our home: our Bosch dishwasher. Gone are our days of intense scrubbing to get every trace of food off our dishes. I can finally experience the joy of putting an actually dirty dish in a dishwasher for it to come out sparkling clean. Commercials had led us to believe we were just buying the wrong soap and our old dishwasher could do this same thing but today I declare them liars. The dishwasher truly does matter and daily I declare my praises of this dishwasher to anyone who will hear it. After every wash cycle I announce to everyone in the room "have I mentioned I love this dishwasher" even if the only one listening is the cat. My dishes are CLEAN. So clean that you could eat off of them! What a concept.

It's slightly less quiet than the uber-quiet Bosh but better in every other way. I especially like the huge 3rd rack which holds a surprising number of sizeable items: Regular coffee cups and 12 oz drink glasware, small cereal bowls and a plethora of flatware, knives, spatulas, etc. The Bosh unit's 3rd rack is a joke by comparison with nearly unusable depth, low quality glides and flimsy overall feel. The Bosh's middle rack glides better but no where near the quality of the Kitchenaid's super glides. I love the huge bottom rack's hefty utensil caddy that spans the front-to-back of the washer with a quality handle. The Bosh, OTOH sports a ridiculously small super-cheap comically flimsy utensil rack that seems like it came from an off-brand $350 dishwasher. What were they thinking? The dual-sided interior lighting in the Kitchenaid is useful and a novel useful feature for us. I love the easily accessible 1-to-24 hour delay feature for off-peak washing. The Bosh unit had *NO DELAY CONTROLS* on the dishwasher itself, a major fail. To set a delay you'd have to dig down multiple layers in the phone app to access it, uber-inconvenient! The Bosh had a downward projector telling you what phase the wash was in but NO indicator of when the cycle was complete! The projector was weak and difficult to read on sautlilo tiles. The Kitchenaid, OTOH displays an easily visible led indicator - blue for wash, red for dry and white when complete - simple and effective. Finally, the wash quality and drying are top notch, the drying superior to the Bosh unit. Overall, highly recommended

Sentence (English): It is such a pleasure to have the new Bosch dishwasher installed.
Comments (English): [ Excellent quality! Spotless dishes and quiet! ] || ---------------- || It is such a pleasure to have the new Bosch dishwasher installed. I love how quiet it is! My old dishwasher made enough noise it could be heard through the whole house. With the Bosch, however, I hardly even know it's running unless I'm in the kitchen when it drains. My two favorite features are the auto wash / auto dry and the top utensil drawer. Auto wash saves energy by starting with a quick rinse that determines the length and amount of water necessary to clean the dishes depending on how dirty they are. At first, I was sceptical of the auto dry feature. When the cycle finishes, the door pops open and the dishes air dry. It works like a charm and saves energy. Dishes are dry and spotless. The top utensil drawer is one of the main reasons I chose this dishwasher. Instead of a basket with everything jammed in, utensils are separated and evereything gets clean because there is no nesting of spoons or other items. There's even room for oversized cooking utensils. It's now easier to put utensils away after the wash. You just slide out the drawer and scoop up all the spoons, and then the forks, etc., and put them away. I also love not having to stoop over to get to them. Such an inprovement over the old silverware basket which crowded utensils. There is a basket available, but I just took it out and put it in a cabinet — I don't see any reason to use it unless I have an awful lot of extra cooking utensils.

Sentence (English): Fantastic dishwasher - much better than the similarly priced Bosh unit it replaced.
Comments (English): [ Fantastic product ] || ---------------- || Fantastic dishwasher - much better than the similarly priced Bosh unit it replaced. It's slightly less quiet than the uber-quiet Bosh but better in every other way. I especially like the huge 3rd rack which holds a surprising number of sizeable items: Regular coffee cups and 12 oz drink glasware, small cereal bowls and a plethora of flatware, knives, spatulas, etc. The Bosh unit's 3rd rack is a joke by comparison with nearly unusable depth, low quality glides and flimsy overall feel. The Bosh's middle rack glides better but no where near the quality of the Kitchenaid's super glides. I love the huge bottom rack's hefty utensil caddy that spans the front-to-back of the washer with a quality handle. The Bosh, OTOH sports a ridiculously small super-cheap comically flimsy utensil rack that seems like it came from an off-brand $350 dishwasher. What were they thinking? The dual-sided interior lighting in the Kitchenaid is useful and a novel useful feature for us. I love the easily accessible 1-to-24 hour delay feature for off-peak washing. The Bosh unit had *NO DELAY CONTROLS* on the dishwasher itself, a major fail. To set a delay you'd have to dig down multiple layers in the phone app to access it, uber-inconvenient! The Bosh had a downward projector telling you what phase the wash was in but NO indicator of when the cycle was complete! The projector was weak and difficult to read on sautlilo tiles. The Kitchenaid, OTOH displays an easily visible led indicator - blue for wash, red for dry and white when complete - simple and effective. Finally, the wash quality and drying are top notch, the drying superior to the Bosh unit when in the ProDry mode. Overall, highly recommended

I like the new simpler pull out trays with fewer movable parts to break. But I am definitely not a fan of the new utensil basket. I don't actually know how new this design is since my last dishwasher was installed in 2012. But this is just bad. I understand the reasoning behind the changes. But this new basket design is very limiting in both the quantity and style of utensils and flatware that can be loaded. In fact the slots of this basket are too narrow to accommodate one of my good sets of Oneida flatware that flare a bit at the ends. The slot design requires running the DW more often because it limits the quantity of utensils that can be loaded. And this basket design requires the user to unload utensils by grabbing the eating surfaces rather than the handles. E One final remark: the User Manual is as bare bones as you can get. Good customer service anticipates the user's experience. I shouldn't have to google something from a non-KA source because the manual doesn't answer a very basic question.

Sentence (English): New kitchen also means new dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ So far a great thing with some caveats ] || ---------------- || New kitchen also means new dishwasher. I chose this one because Beko is a strong brand. Not too expensive but good quality. It says that this appliance is not super quiet. Well compared to my old one this is an electric car vs a car with a V8 engine. How quiet this is. The arm at the bottom reaches into all the nooks and crannies. Still have to figure out how best to pack the machine, but that will come with time. The only disadvantage is that it makes a very high pitched beep when it starts. Are your ears not that young? Then you don't notice it. Young ears quickly think that they have spontaneously developed tinnitus. Close the door or leave it ajar and you're done with it. The door opens automatically when it's done. A few strong programs. Overall I'm happy. Especially when I compare it to the (fairly new) dishwashers that are at my sister's, best friend's and my mother's. Then this is still the quietest
Comments (Original): [ Tot op heden super ding met wat kanttekeningen ] || ---------------- || Nieuwe keuken betekend ook nieuwe vaatwasser. Ik heb voor deze gekozen omdat beko een sterk merk is. Niet te duur maar wel goeie kwaliteit. Er staat dat dit apparaat niet super stil is. Nou in vergelijken met mijn oude is dit een elektrische auto vs een auto met v8 motor. Wat is deze stil. Armpje onderaan komt in alle hoekjes en gaatjes. Nog even uitvogelen hoe ik het beste de machine kan inpakken, maar dat komt met de tijd wel. Enige nadeel is dat hij een flinke hoge piep maakt wanneer hij start. Zijn je oortjes niet zo jong? Dan merk je er niks van. Jonge oortjes denken al snel dat ze spontaan tinitus hebben gekregen. Deurtje dicht of op een kier en daar ben je ook weer vanaf. Deur gaat automatisch open wanneer het klaar is. Paar sterke programma's. Overall ben ik blij. Zeker als ik hem vergelijk met de (redelijk nieuwe) vaatwassers die staan bij mijn zus, beste vriendin en mijn moeder.  Dan is deze nog steeds de stilste

This has been one of the most disappointing and frustrating retail experiences I have encountered in my 40 years.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher functioning is great.
Comments (English): [ I do not recommend buying this dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher functioning is great. Dishes come out clean, quiet operation, no complaints about that. The problem is with the racks. The wires are designed so that you can lay them flat to fit larger items, that is nice. However they are very thin so I hope they do not break in a year or so. The bottom rack is terrible for a couple of reasons. The spacing of the rack leaves big gaps so that the dishes poke through the bottom and block the spray arm. There are VERY few pegs so if you have anything other than very large items they can't go on the bottom, which means you are running the dishwasher not full. Lastly the silverware caddy. It takes up almost 1/4 of the space of the rack and is not easily accessible. We ended up using one from our old dishwasher but it doesn't fit snugly due to the large gaps in the bottom rack grid. I definitely feel like I overpaid for this dishwasher and I would not recommend it due to the poor design and flimsy racks/pegs.

Sentence (English): On May 22, I purchased a Bosch dishwasher from bestbuy.
Comments (English): [ Worst Customer Service Ever ] || ---------------- || On May 22, I purchased a Bosch dishwasher from Best Buy. After two unsuccessful installation attempts, Best Buy left the dishwasher at my home. I managed to get it installed on June 1, only to find that it was defective—it would not drain or dry my dishes. I contacted Bosch customer service and despite the product being only 9 days old, they wanted me to pay for someone to come out and service the machine. We ran multiple tests and the dishwasher simply would not drain properly and left the dishes soaking wet after each attempt. I had purchased the 5 year extended warranty from Best Buy. And I was certain they could help me when Bosch couldn't. I contacted Best Buy customer service, and they informed me that while they could replace the dishwasher, I would need to pay for the installation. This was contrary to the original purchase agreement, which included free installation. I refused to pay for the additional service, resulting in them retrieving the defective dishwasher. I pleaded both in-store and over the phone for them to honor the sale's original terms, including free installation and delivery, but I was repeatedly denied. During my visit to the store, I waited for half an hour before anyone approached me. When I asked to speak with a manager, my request was denied, with the staff claiming there was nothing they could do. I received the same response from customer service over the phone. This has been one of the most disappointing and frustrating retail experiences I have encountered in my 40 years.

Sentence (English): The assembly/installation took about 2 hours, this included removing the old dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Super quiet ] || ---------------- || The assembly/installation took about 2 hours, this included removing the old dishwasher. The instructions seemed out of sequence but once started working into the cabinet and aligning these kinda made sense. Recommend setting leveling feet with tape measure to equalize before sliding the unit into place. This will get unit very close to level ( assuming the floor underneath is sound and level. Insulation blanket was quite loose , it was resecured using aluminum duct work tape. Adjusting door springs is challenging as the instructions show multiple points to connect the spring, This unit only has on place. Installing Electrical cord, unit did not come with terminal strip like other dishwasher, a small strip will fit and mount inside the box to eliminate wire nutting plug in cord to unit wiring. Unit is running thru the first complete cycle at present but is very quiet. Wife likes third rack design and second rack height adjustment. THis will be the third dishwasher install in 8 years, removed a GE when remodeling 8 years ago. When with a commonly know Korean manufacture first, unit lasted exactly 2 months after warranty expired. Replaced with a another big name dishwasher, lasted 3 years when garbage designed laminated pump , delaminated, and caused pump motor to burn up. The GE unit we removed originally had been in the house 8 years as was only removed due to remodel, Now we're full circle back to GE.

The spokes are arranged in a useful manner. You can put silverware on the top (3rd) rack or in the silverware basket on the bottom shelf. That basket can be split between 2 smaller baskets and the larger one with the handle. The reasons this dishwasher does not get 5 stars is that the bottom basket aligns crookedly with the door so it doesn't pull out on the rails well. The bottom tray overlaps the door frame on the right side but not the left, leaving me to believe that the door is closer to the dishwasher frame on the left or that the tray rests on the dishwasher rails at an angle to the door. The door hinges are tight and seem tighter on the left side than the right so it is hard to open the door when it is latched and hard to bring it down flat so the tray can be pulled onto it for unloading dishes. The Whirlpool technician who came out to see if anything could be done about these issues said the tray was perfectly fine being crooked and that the door was not more difficult to open than it should be. This is the first dishwasher of many we've had that has had these kind of problems. That these problems are considered "normal" for a Whirlpool dishwasher is a problem in itself.

Sentence (English): Having heard nothing but glowing reviews about Bosch dishwashers, I first set my eyes on a 600 series with the auto-opening door.
Comments (English): [ The whole package ] || ---------------- || Having heard nothing but glowing reviews about Bosch dishwashers, I first set my eyes on a 600 series with the auto-opening door. A tiny bit of research later I discovered the theoretical magic of CrystalDry and as a mechanical engineer, was taken aback by the brilliance of this integration. A no-maintenance item that dries better and uses less energy for a minimal cost increase hardly every happens, so while skeptical I took the plunge. This is simply the best dishwasher in every respect I've every had/used. The interior is large and flexible to you can fit and wash whatever you need. It washes better on the Auto cycle than most dishwashers on their Heavy cycles, while using significantly less energy. Dishes are almost completely dry at the end of the cycle, which is more impressive in comparison to our old dishwasher (a 4-year-old mid-grade Frigidaire) after a fully wash dry cycle we would immediately open the door and after 12 hours, still had to dump excess water off some of the dishes. Add to that the connected app, ability to select heavy or light wash in different quadrants of the bottom rack, and tracking of water/energy AND detergent pods (Yeah, it will remind you when you're low on pods, since it's tracking the number of cycles you've run! ) this product couldn't be any better. Considering we picked it up for less than an iPhone Pro Max, it was a steal and we'll get our money's worth time and time again.

Sentence (English): She's lived in this house for 35 years.
Comments (English): [ As a gift for my parents ] || ---------------- || She's lived in this house for 35 years. She's gotten older and it's become difficult for her to clean, so my older brother and I helped her fix it. Meanwhile, I was very, very determined to get the dishwasher. I use a Samsung Bespoke 6-seater, and my wrist pain has significantly improved since I started using it in my 40s. Men don't understand how hard it is to wash heavy pots and dishes every day. I bought it because I absolutely had to. Since our house is large, when people gather, my mom has to cook and wash the dishes alone. We can't help her, and the occasional high-temperature sterilization with the dishwasher is very hygienic, so I bought a three-stage dishwasher. I also occasionally turn the hood cover, and for smaller loads, I just put it in the sink basket and turn it one level. She actually used this when we were here, and she did it by hand, but it's still great for family gatherings. I think it's a great idea. This model uses salt to soften tap water, but honestly, it doesn't matter if you don't add it. It only removes water stains. Some places give you conditioner for free with detergent purchases, and if you don't use conditioner, it's not a major inconvenience and you can just ignore it. A big reason I chose this model was the three-drawer design. I used a small one, so the spoons would overlap, and sometimes I'd forget to wash one or two of the baby's dishes. But when I spread it out and washed them, it washed them incredibly cleanly. I'm completely satisfied. When washing plastic, try to avoid high temperatures. The detergent box? They say you should pour the detergent into the hole and press the "run" button, but you can just toss it inside. Sometimes, when you put detergent in the box, the plastic gets caught and the detergent doesn't come out cleanly, leaving some behind. I just break one or half and throw it on the floor. Or, when washing baby bottles, I buy a single-stage detergent and spray it on the floor. My mom said she's so happy to have you, saying her son doesn't understand a woman's heart. The technician was also very kind. Thank you.

Sentence (English): Super Quiet-Spacious Interior!
Comments (English): [ Best Dishwasher I Have Ever Owned! ] || ---------------- || Super Quiet-Spacious Interior! We thought our old dishwasher did a very good job and we were sorry to see it go, but the kitchen remodel and age of our old machine necessitated we get a new model. We bought 6 Cafe appliances and I must say, they are all awesome! Specifically the dishwasher now. Like I said earlier, quiet as a mouse and very spacious interior. I can fit almost any item without a problem. When we take our dishes out, they look like they have been polished! There is no residual wetness on ANY of the dishes! We are washing all of the other dishes and glasses in the cabinets now because if they haven't gone through this machine, they look dull.Wi-Fi is fantastic and if you are debating about taking the time to hook up all your Cafe Appliances, JUST DO IT. The machines will auto update their electronic brains. The App lets you check the status of any operating appliance.Now, there is one negative and this is my opinion. The instructions, videos and whatever support Cafe/GE say they have to help you hook up these appliances to Wi-Fi is SEVERELY LACKING. The oven was easy, but the rest of my appliances were took me a long time. In the end, it was worth taking the time. GE/Cafe needs to create USEFUL instructions for each of these appliances, not just a generic, outdated, and confusing instructions. Full disclosure. This is a replacement machine. The one delivered had a damaged front panel. GE said they would send a repairman out an replace the panel and we were anxious to get the dishwasher installed, so we said ok. After the second cycle, the machine detected an internal water leak. In hindsight, we should not have accepted delivery. External damage is very possibly an indication of internal damage. That being said, we called our dealer (Plaza Appliance Mart of Charlotte, NC) and told them we needed a replacement machine. The salesperson did not hesitate. She had a replacement being shipped that very day. That kind of dealer support is priceless! New one installed a week later, and we are thrilled! Final note. We elected to have our kitchen contractor take care of the installation of our appliances instead of Plaza Appliance Mart. Another mistake. Should have gone with Plaza Appliance Mart.

Sentence (English): As a family of 6, we can sometimes need to run our dishwasher 3 times in a day.
Comments (English): [ Quick wash one of the best features for large family ] || ---------------- || As a family of 6, we can sometimes need to run our dishwasher 3 times in a day. The typical high efficiency dishwashers seem to take forever to complete their cycles, making that need hard to satisfy. Not having the space at the moment for two, we need our dishwasher to be quick, so I was intrigued by the 1 hour wash and dry time boasted on the door of this one. Tested and confirmed, one hour start to finish but be wary, dishes are hot when it's done! Don't forget you'll need a water supply line and a pigtail for power, nice that those connections are in the front at the kick plate, though a bit awkward to get connected when the dishwasher is in place. Quiet running (if you turn off the control panel beeps)WiFi enabled so I can let the kids know when it's done to empty it out3 racksStainless tubDishes seemed cleaner than the one it replaced though and that was likely just age making it less efficient. All in a solid machine.

Sentence (English): Can you buy it even if it means tearing out and repairing the lower cabinet?
Comments (English): . #Participation in Samsung Electronics event. Today is finally the day! I would like to tell you about my aunt’s review of the #dishwasher that we brought to our house! nice! I'm really crying. About 3 years ago, when I moved into my current house, I wanted to buy a dishwasher, so I looked into LG, Samsung, etc., but the cabinet under the sink did not fit 12 to 14 people, and it was difficult to fit 6 people. I thought about using pink as an accent, but I thought it was too much, so I went with white! Please enter a photo description. After you place your order, you will receive a text message like this on KakaoTalk! You can specify the day you want installation! First, a technician for pre-installation reform work will visit you before installation, and then a product delivery engineer will visit you! You will be visiting twice in total! The technician comes on the promised schedule and blocks the baseboard of the sink or any remaining space, and performs remodeling work. Well, it looks like the renovation work has been completed. And like this, the product delivery and installation engineer will visit you. We visited as a group of two! It's a hot day, so thank you for your hard work! (The air conditioner was turned on full blast ^-^) . Ta-da~ #Built-in My aunt’s dishwasher has finally been installed. Is it really possible to look at real electronic products with such pride? Dishwashing hell,,, Escape,,,, Oh my god! >.< . This is what it looks like after setting the dishes! Does Samsung have high temperatures like LG? They say it's not so it leaves some moisture? Since I knew something, I wasn’t that disappointed! There's a lot of moisture left in the baby bottle, so I'll have to transfer the moisture to #Yupang! . Other than that, I was surprised that the glass dishes and cups became really hard,,,, Wow,,, it’s better than what I used to do.,, . A warm escape from dishwashing hell. This was a review of the Samsung Bespoke 8-person dishwasher #dishwasher! Thank you for reading this long article^^

Sentence (English): A warm escape from dishwashing hell.
Comments (English): . #Participation in Samsung Electronics event. Today is finally the day! I would like to tell you about my aunt’s review of the #dishwasher that we brought to our house! nice! I thought about using pink as an accent, but I thought it was too much, so I went with white! Please enter a photo description. After you place your order, you will receive a text message like this on KakaoTalk! You can specify the day you want installation! The technician comes on the promised schedule and blocks the baseboard of the sink or any remaining space, and performs remodeling work. Well, it looks like the renovation work has been completed. And like this, the product delivery and installation engineer will visit you. We visited as a group of two! It's a hot day, so thank you for your hard work! (The air conditioner was turned on full blast ^-^) . Ta-da~ #Built-in My aunt’s dishwasher has finally been installed. Is it really possible to look at real electronic products with such pride? Other than that, I was surprised that the glass dishes and cups became really hard,,,, Wow,,, it’s better than what I used to do.,, . A warm escape from dishwashing hell. This was a review of the Samsung Bespoke 8-person dishwasher #dishwasher! Thank you for reading this long article^^

Comments (English): [ Unexpected cost maybe don't purchase online ] || ---------------- || I don't have a problem with the dishwasher, it seems fine, but I would like to make buyers aware that if you don't have a dedicated outlet for your dishwasher alone you may have an issue. If your electrical outlet is under your kitchen sink and you have a disposal, you may have a problem if the disposal is in the top outlet. The cords they send in the basic install kit are three prong, and when they plug into the outlet, the actual cord runs vertically toward the ceiling, not toward a baseboard. So if you have a disposal plugged into your upper outlet on a switch under your kitchen sink, and the dishwasher plugs into the bottom outlet, due to the cord configuration, you can't actually keep the disposal plugged in. The tech told me we could use an extension cord to plug in the dishwasher, but I'm not going to have an extension cord coiled up under my kitchen sink. Since the disposal runs on a switch, you can't simply trade the cord positions. The dishwasher cord cannot go on the switch outlet and the disposal cord can't run without a switch outlet. Bottom line I will need to either have someone move the dishwasher out and replace the cord when I find the right one and put it back together or have an electrician switch out my outlets. This will be an unexpected cost, and it wasn't until the end of the install the problem was recognized or mentioned. I personally have not seen cords that run upside down like that. What a pain! When I called technical support they were sympathetic, but said that was the basic install kit. It's on me if I need to replace the cord or have an electrician switch out the outlet. So heads up you may be better off buying from a local source where there can be more one-on-one communication and desire to help solve a problem.
